jobs.title: Project Manager
jobs.description:
About The Role

In this role you will manage data-centric projects — from Data Warehouse and Data Lake implementations to BI solutions and data & analytics migrations — as part of SoftServe's Big Data & Analytics Center of Excellence. You will lead cross-functional teams of engineers and architects, oversee the full project lifecycle from PoC to full-scale delivery, and work with customers ranging from global enterprises to early-stage start-ups across healthcare, finance, manufacturing, retail, and energy.

Responsibilities

Manage data-centric projects such as Data Warehouse/Data Lake implementations, BI solutions, and data & analytics migrations
Lead dedicated project teams of 20+ engineers and manage fixed-price contracts
Own key project management areas: cost, scope & schedule, stakeholders, risk, and quality
Apply Agile, Scrum, Waterfall, or Kanban methodologies as appropriate, using tools like Jira and Trello
Identify, assess, and mitigate project risks throughout the project lifecycle
Resolve conflicts within project teams and with stakeholders
Guide projects through the entire lifecycle — from design and PoC to MVP and full-scale implementation
Collaborate with technology partners (AWS, GCP, Microsoft, Databricks, Snowflake, Confluent, and others) and support local and regional initiatives
Travel for business trips as needed
Support technical and personal growth of the team, and contribute to knowledge-sharing within the SoftServe Data Community

Requirements

4+ years of experience in project management
Experience managing data-centric projects (Data Warehouse/Data Lake, BI solutions, data & analytics migrations)
High-level understanding of modern data technologies
Eagerness to continuously learn in both project management and technology
Knowledge of Agile, Scrum, Waterfall, and Kanban methodologies, and familiarity with Jira and Trello
Strong conflict mitigation and resolution skills
Experience leading dedicated teams and managing fixed-price contracts
Proficiency in risk management
Experience leading project teams of 20+ engineers
Hands-on expertise in cost, scope & schedule, stakeholder, risk, and quality management
Fluent English with excellent verbal and written communication skills

SoftServe is an equal opportunity employer. Qualified applicants will receive consideration regardless of race, color, ancestry, ethnicity, national origin, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, citizenship, disability, health condition, marital or family status, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

jobs.title: Senior Project Manager-3
jobs.description:
Job Description Summary

As a Senior Project Manager at GE Vernova, you will be responsible for the successful execution and delivery of complex Grid Automation projects with customer full satisfaction. These projects involve a combination of protection relays, bay controller units, auxiliary relays, telecom equipment (switches, routers, firewalls), and servers running various applications such as human-machine interfaces, automation algorithms, and archiving processes.

The Senior Project Manager is responsible for financial and contractual execution of assigned projects through established company procedures, maintaining a high standard of Safety, Quality, on-time delivery, scope management, risk mitigation, and financial control.

Solid communication skills will be a key asset for the Senior Project Manager while reporting project progress to key stakeholders, including customers, end users, internal team members and leadership.

Job Description

Essential Responsibilities:

Project Execution:

Lead the execution of complex projects within the Grid Automation solutions domain.
Ensure alignment of project goals with overall business objectives.
Manage project budgets, timelines, and resources effectively.
Ensure safety and quality through the overall execution cycle.

Stakeholder Management:
Collaborate with internal and external stakeholders, including clients, vendors, and cross-functional teams.
Ensure clear communication and manage expectations throughout the life cycle of all projects in the portfolio.
Create a strong customer intimacy and ensure its satisfaction during execution.

Project Planning, Scheduling and Resources:
Develop detailed project plans, including timelines, milestones, and resource allocation.
Utilize planning and scheduling tools to monitor progress, manage the critical path and deliver the project in time.
Ensure optimal usage of project resources partnering with the Engineering and Services department.
Project Budget:
Ensure optimal budget control developing clear work breakdown structure and monitoring Earned Value (EV) also called Budgeted Cost of Work Performed (BCWP).

Enhance project financial defining saving strategy and maximizing variation orders during execution.

Risk Management:
Identify, assess, and mitigate risks identified during project execution.
Implement contingency plans to address unforeseen challenges.

Quality Assurance:
Ensure all project deliverables meet quality standards and regulatory requirements.
Conduct regular reviews and audits to maintain high standards of project execution.

Reporting and Documentation:
Prepare and present regular status reports to senior management and stakeholders.
Maintain accurate and comprehensive project documentation.

Required Qualifications

Education:
Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Business Administration, or a related field. Master’s degree preferred.

Experience:
Minimum of 7 years of experience in project management within the energy or Grid Automation sector.
Proven experience in managing complex, multi-faceted projects.
Experience with protection relays, bay controller units, auxiliary relays, and telecom equipment is highly desirable.

Certifications:
PMP (Project Management Professional) or equivalent certification preferred.
Additional certifications in Grid Automation or related technologies are a plus.

Skills:
Strong leadership and team management skills.
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
Proficiency in project management tools and software (e.g., MS Project, Jira).
Analytical mindset with strong problem-solving abilities.
Ability to travel to customer sites and offices as required by the project plan (around 20%)

Desired Characteristics

Deep understanding of Grid Automation solutions and industry standards.
Experience with telecom equipment and network infrastructure.
Knowledge of automation algorithms and human-machine interfaces.
Ability to work in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.

Additional Information

GE Vernova offers a great work environment, professional development, challenging careers, and competitive compensation. GE Vernova is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, national or ethnic origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, disability, protected veteran status or other characteristics protected by law.

GE Vernova will only employ those who are legally authorized to work in the United States for this opening. Any offer of employment is conditioned upon the successful completion of a drug screen (as applicable).

Relocation Assistance Provided:
No

This is a remote position

Application Deadline: October 01, 2026

For candidates applying to a U.S. based position, the pay range for this position is between $114,100.00 and $190,200.00. The Company pays a geographic differential of 110%, 120% or 130% of salary in certain areas. The specific pay offered may be influenced by a variety of factors, including the candidate’s experience, education, and skill set.

Bonus eligibility: discretionary annual bonus.

This posting is expected to remain open for at least seven days after it was posted on September 24, 2026.

Available benefits include medical, dental, vision, and prescription drug coverage; access to Health Coach from GE Vernova, a 24/7 nurse-based resource; and access to the Employee Assistance Program, providing 24/7 confidential assessment, counseling and referral services. Retirement benefits include the GE Vernova Retirement Savings Plan, a tax-advantaged 401(k) savings opportunity with company matching contributions and company retirement contributions, as well as access to Fidelity resources and financial planning consultants. Other benefits include tuition assistance, adoption assistance, paid parental leave, disability benefits, life insurance, 12 paid holidays, and permissive time off.

GE Vernova Inc. or its affiliates (collectively or individually, “GE Vernova”) sponsor certain employee benefit plans or programs GE Vernova reserves the right to terminate, amend, suspend, replace, or modify its benefit plans and programs at any time and for any reason, in its sole discretion. No individual has a vested right to any benefit under a GE Vernova welfare benefit plan or program. This document does not create a contract of employment with any individual.

jobs.description:
About Mission Underwriting Services

At Mission Underwriters, we provide the capital, issuing paper, and reinsurance access you need to launch your own Program Administrator (PA) business quickly and efficiently. We offer non-recourse capital for qualified underwriters, giving you a manageable risk profile with potential equity upside. By taking care of administrative complexities like compliance, risk management, accounting, and HR, we free you to focus on what you do best underwriting and distribution. Our turnkey platform gets you into the market in just a few months, minimizing disruption to your key relationships. With access to our network of highly rated issuing carriers and reinsurance partners, you can secure coverage with less stress and uncertainty. Built from the ground up, our purpose-driven technology simplifies workflows, enhances responsiveness, and eliminates the burden of outdated legacy systems.

What We Offer

Remote First Work Environment (US Based)
Medical, Dental, Vision
401K, 401K Match
Life and Disability Benefits
Unaccrued Paid Time Off
11 Paid Holidays
Employee Discounts
Employee Assistance Program
Educational Assistance Program
Employee Referral Program
Paid Parental Leave

About The Role

The Project Manager is accountable for the successful delivery of complex, cross-functional business and technology initiatives within a fast-paced Insurtech environment. This position leads projects from planning through implementation, transition, and closeout, ensuring that intended business outcomes are achieved within approved scope, schedule, budget, quality, and risk parameters.

The Project Manager provides structure and leadership across multidisciplinary teams that may include insurance operations, underwriting, product, technology, data, finance, compliance, legal, and external partners. This individual is accountable for planning, coordinating, governing, and delivering projects including driving execution, facilitating critical decisions, managing competing priorities, and maintaining accountability across all levels of the project.

Successful candidates will combine disciplined project management expertise with business acumen, sound judgment, and the ability to lead through influence in an evolving, technology-enabled insurance organization.

Key Responsibilities

Project Leadership and Delivery

Lead complex business, operational, product, and technology projects from initiation through implementation and closeout.
Establish the project governance and delivery structure, scope, objectives, success measures, milestones, and implementation approach.
Translate strategic business objectives into actionable project plans with clearly defined deliverables, owners, dependencies, and timelines.
Assume accountability for overall project performance, including scope, schedule, budget, quality, risk, and business outcomes.
Drive project execution across cross-functional teams, ensuring that commitments are understood, monitored, and completed.
Maintain delivery momentum by identifying obstacles, resolving conflicts, and facilitating timely decisions.
Evaluate project performance and implement corrective actions when results deviate from approved plans.
Ensure projects transition successfully into ongoing business operations, with clear ownership and support models following implementation.

Scope, Schedule, and Budget Management

Define, validate, and manage project scope in partnership with executive sponsors, business owners, and key stakeholders.
Develop and maintain integrated project plans that account for business, operational, technical, vendor, and regulatory dependencies.
Establish realistic schedules based on project complexity, resource capacity, organizational priorities, and implementation requirements.
Develop, manage, and monitor project budgets, forecasts, vendor costs, and financial performance, as applicable.
Assess the impact of requested changes to scope, schedule, cost, resources, risk, and anticipated benefits.
Lead formal change-control processes and obtain appropriate stakeholder approval before implementing material changes.
Provide transparent reporting on project health, financial status, delivery risks, and forecasted outcomes.

Risk, Issue, and Dependency Management

Proactively identify, assess, and manage project risks, issues, assumptions, constraints, and dependencies.
Develop mitigation, contingency, and recovery plans for risks that could affect delivery or business outcomes.
Evaluate the business impact and urgency of project issues and drive timely resolution with accountable owners.
Escalate significant decisions, risks, resource constraints, and delivery concerns to project sponsors and PMO leadership.
Monitor dependencies across projects, systems, business areas, vendors, and implementation workstreams.
Apply sound judgment to balance speed, quality, cost, risk, and business value when recommending a course of action.
Maintain clear decision, risk, issue, and change records throughout the project lifecycle.

Stakeholder and Executive Management

Serve as the primary delivery leader and central point of accountability for assigned projects.
Establish productive working relationships with executive sponsors, business leaders, subject matter experts, technology teams, vendors, and implementation partners.
Clarify roles, decision rights, escalation paths, and stakeholder expectations at the beginning of each project.
Provide concise, decision-oriented updates to executives, steering committees, and governance groups.
Present project recommendations, alternatives, tradeoffs, risks, and business impacts in a clear and actionable manner.
Facilitate alignment when stakeholders have competing goals, priorities, or perspectives.
Build consensus and secure decisions necessary to maintain project progress.
Manage stakeholder expectations throughout the project lifecycle and communicate changes proactively.

Cross-Functional Team Leadership

Lead multidisciplinary project teams across insurance operations, underwriting, product, technology, data, finance, legal, compliance, and other business functions.
Establish a culture of accountability, collaboration, transparency, and results within the project team.
Define project roles and responsibilities and ensure team members understand their commitments.
Partner with functional leaders to secure qualified project resources and address competing capacity demands.
Facilitate effective collaboration between business and technology teams.
Hold workstream leaders and project contributors accountable for agreed deliverables and deadlines.
Support productive conflict resolution and remove barriers that could affect team performance or delivery.
Provide project direction without relying on formal supervisory authority.

Technology and Insurtech Delivery

Lead initiatives involving insurance platforms, digital products, workflow automation, systems integration, data solutions, operational transformation, or customer-facing technology.
Partner with product, engineering, data, quality assurance, information security, and business teams throughout the delivery lifecycle.
Coordinate business and technical workstreams to ensure requirements, solution design, testing, implementation, and operational readiness remain aligned.
Ensure that business requirements and expected outcomes are understood and traceable throughout project delivery.
Manage project activities across Agile, Waterfall, and hybrid delivery models based on the needs of the initiative.
Coordinate release planning, testing readiness, deployment activities, implementation support, and post-launch stabilization.
Work with appropriate partners to ensure projects consider security, privacy, compliance, data integrity, and operational-resilience requirements.
Support the successful integration of third-party platforms and external technology partners.

Insurance Operations and Regulatory Alignment

Develop an understanding of the insurance processes, products, controls, and operating models affected by each project.
Partner with underwriting, operations, claims, finance, actuarial, compliance, legal, and technology stakeholders as required by the initiative.
Ensure relevant regulatory, contractual, audit, security, and compliance considerations are incorporated into project plans.
Identify operational impacts resulting from changes to systems, workflows, products, data, or business processes.
Coordinate with control functions to obtain required reviews, approvals, and documentation.
Promote solutions that improve scalability, data quality, operational efficiency, customer experience, and business performance.
Ensure project teams appropriately document material decisions, requirements, controls, and approvals.

Vendor and Partner Management

Manage project activities involving software providers, consultants, implementation partners, and other third parties.
Integrate vendor plans, milestones, dependencies, and deliverables into the overall project plan.
Monitor vendor performance against contractual commitments, project requirements, delivery dates, and quality expectations.
Facilitate resolution of vendor-related risks, delivery gaps, and dependency issues.
Partner with procurement, legal, information security, finance, and business owners throughout vendor selection and implementation activities.
Review vendor recommendations and challenge assumptions when necessary to protect project objectives.
Escalate material vendor performance concerns and support the development of corrective-action plans.

Change Management and Business Readiness

Assess how project outcomes will affect employees, customers, partners, workflows, systems, controls, and organizational responsibilities.
Integrate change management, communication, training, adoption, and business-readiness activities into the overall delivery plan.
Partner with business leaders and change management resources to identify impacted stakeholder groups and adoption risks.
Ensure impacted teams are prepared to operate new processes, systems, products, or capabilities before implementation.
Establish implementation-readiness criteria and facilitate go-live decisions with project sponsors and operational owners.
Monitor adoption, stabilization, and early performance following implementation.
Ensure ownership is formally transitioned to the appropriate business and operational teams.

Governance and Performance Reporting

Establish project governance that supports effective oversight, timely decisions, and clear accountability.
Lead steering committee meetings, executive reviews, project working sessions, and delivery checkpoints.
Develop accurate project status reports, executive presentations, dashboards, forecasts, and decision materials.
Provide objective assessments of project health rather than relying solely on completed activities or reported progress.
Monitor delivery performance against approved scope, schedule, budget, quality, risk, and benefit expectations.
Ensure project records and approvals meet PMO governance and documentation requirements.
Conduct project closeout reviews and capture lessons learned, delivery insights, and improvement opportunities.
Contribute to the continued development of PMO standards, methodologies, governance practices, and portfolio reporting.

Required Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Project Management, Information Systems, Technology, Finance, Insurance, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and relevant experience.
Five or more years of project management experience, including direct accountability for complex, cross-functional initiatives.
Demonstrated experience leading projects through the complete lifecycle, from business case and planning through implementation and closeout.

jobs.title: Senior Technical Project Manager, LatAm (all genders)
jobs.description:
Distribusion
is the world’s leading ground transportation marketplace and gives travellers seamless access to ground transportation online, from search to ticket purchase. We have built a cutting-edge B2B technology platform that connects bus, rail, and ferry operators in 70+ countries with the biggest online retailers, including Google and Booking.com.
We are shaping the future of travel and building the largest global network of transport providers and retailers. Having grown 10x in the past year, we are one of the fastest-growing startups in travel. Backed by four leading VCs (TQ Ventures, Creandum, Northzone, and Lightrock), and now, following our recent $80 m Series C, we are ready to push beyond.

As a Senior Technical Project Manager,
you will lead our most strategically important client projects in the region.

What you will do:

Lead pre-sales and delivery of complex API and e-commerce projects, acting as the primary point of contact for external partners, while facilitating collaboration between their teams and Distribusion’s Engineering, Product, and Operations functions.
Develop blueprint processes for the rollout of standard product offerings.
Guide product development by systematically capturing market needs and partner insights.

Workplace:
Berlin/Hybrid or Europe/Remote.
We collaborate with teams around the Globe and our HQ in Berlin, where the Berlin team often meets in the office.

Who you are:

You have 4+ years managing technical projects or solution delivery, including in a consulting or high growth environment
You are confident navigating technical topics like API integrations, architecture diagrams, and e-commerce, even if you’re not the one coding.
You’re a structured communicator who can translate complexity into clarity for both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
You take ownership, thrive in ambiguity, and are energised by solving cross-functional coordination challenges.
You are business fluent in English and Spanish, both written and spoken.
You are open to business travel to our key markets in Latin America.

What you can expect:

You will join a fast-paced travel tech company and take on a rapidly growing industry.
You will take on ownership and responsibility from day one and directly impact the company's success.
We value agility! We’re constantly updating our tech stack and offer the best possible tools to ensure all of our in-house engineers, partners, and carriers benefit from cutting-edge, efficient solutions.
You will work with global companies. Our product attracts the biggest names in travel technology, such as Booking.com and Google Maps, and national carriers like Amtrak, Deutsche Bahn, Renfe, and SNCF.
You will join an international team of talented and driven people with a clear mission. Expect your colleagues to inspire, support and challenge you every day!
We offer flexible and remote working conditions, relocation opportunities and career growth in a small and developing company.

Our hiring process for this role:

Your Talent Partner (TP) and point of contact is Masha Marynova.

For any queries, please reach out to your Talent Partner at (talent@distribusion.com).
Do you want to work in an advanced tech environment and have an impact on millions of travelers around the globe? We want to hear from you!

is a leading mechanical and plumbing contractor, with operations across multiple states, specializing in large-scale commercial and industrial projects. We are known for our focus on cutting-edge fabrication technologies, our commitment to quality craftsmanship, our strong client relationships, and above all, our culture. “We build people” is not just a catchphrase. We are a group of innovators, creatives, and craftsmen, who push boundaries and challenge the status quo. Our culture is centered around empowering our employees to reach their full potential by providing them with opportunities for growth, development, and personal and professional advancement. “ We build people

” who build amazing things.

Traveling Construction Opportunities – Multiple States

Our traveling teams support projects in data centers, semiconductor facilities, advanced manufacturing, industrial facilities, mission-critical environments, and other large-scale commercial projects.

This is an opportunity to work on complex projects, gain experience in multiple markets, and build a career with a growing organization.

is responsible for leading industrial mechanical construction projects across multiple states, from planning and preconstruction through final completion. Our traveling Project Managers have the opportunity to work on large-scale, technically advanced projects

Travel opportunities across multiple states
Per diem for eligible traveling employees
Competitive compensation and benefits
401(k) with company match
Career growth and advancement opportunities
Exposure to high-profile, technically advanced projects
Team-oriented environment where We Build People

Lead industrial mechanical projects from planning through completion.

Your Role And Responsibilities

As ABB Robotics prepares for an exciting new chapter as a standalone global leader in automation, we are undertaking a major transformation of our people processes and systems. To support this journey, we are looking for an experienced Transformation Project Manager
to lead payroll and employee lifecycle transformation initiatives across multiple countries.

This is a unique opportunity to play a key role in shaping the future payroll landscape of a global organization during a period of significant change and growth. You will work in an international environment, collaborating with HR, Payroll, IT, Finance, external partners, and senior stakeholders worldwide.

As Transformation Project Manager, you will lead end-to-end payroll transformation and implementation projects, ensuring successful delivery from discovery and design through deployment and stabilization. You will serve as a key partner to the Global Payroll Transformation Lead and work closely with both local and global stakeholders to establish future-ready payroll and employee lifecycle processes.

The position is a temporary assignment ending October 31, 2027
.

Location:
Flexible within Europe, with a preference for candidates located in Poland, Spain, or the Nordic countries.

Your Responsibilities Will Include

Leading payroll and employee lifecycle transformation projects across multiple countries.
Driving local country discovery activities to understand current processes and define future-state solutions.
Managing project plans, timelines, risks, dependencies, and stakeholder communications.
Coordinating with HR, Payroll, Finance, IT, and external vendors to ensure successful implementation and integration.
Facilitating workshops, gathering business requirements, and supporting solution design.

Supporting change management, training, and transition into operational support.
Ensuring compliance with local legislation, payroll regulations, and company policies.

Qualifications For The Role

Extensive project management experience within payroll, HR transformation, or shared services environments.
Fluency in English and Swedish.
Solid understanding of payroll operations, compliance, and employee lifecycle processes.
Experience supporting organizations operating across Nordic countries.
Proven experience leading payroll implementation projects in complex, multinational organizations.
Strong experience with Workday, including payroll-related processes and integrations.
Experience with Strada, divestments, or carve-out projects is considered an advantage.
Experience working with global and cross-functional teams in a matrix organization.
Excellent stakeholder management, communication, and change management skills.
Willingness to travel occasionally for key workshops and project milestones.
A Bachelor's degree or equivalent professional experience.

More About Us

ABB Robotics is a global technology leader enabling customers to become more productive, flexible, and sustainable through automation. to lead and oversee programmatic execution in support of USSOCOM-assigned organizations. This role is ideal for a seasoned professional with deep experience managing complex DoD contracts and task orders under an IDIQ vehicle. The selected candidate will play a critical role in both program execution and business development, ensuring excellence in contract performance and driving the pursuit of new task orders.

Lead the management and execution of all aspects of the IDIQ contract, including oversight of task orders, staffing, performance, and customer engagement.

Ability to provide business development and proposal support for new and existing Task Orders, including but not limited to: Recruiting incumbent personnel, conducting pricing analysis, responding to RFPs, performing teaming analysis and executing capture responsibilities to help secure new work.

10+ years of total experience working in USSOCOM assigned organizations as a military member, government civilian, or contractor

Master’s degree in Program Management or any Business-related field

Familiarity with USSOCOM HQs and component commands, including JSOC, USASOC, NAVSPECWARCOM, AFSOC, MARSOC, and associated TSOCs

jobs.title: Project Manager – IT / Scrum
jobs.description:
This Job is based in Australia

Employment Type: Full-time (35 hours per week)
Duration: Fixed-term contract (2 years until June 2028)
Remuneration: $132,445 - $149,228 + 17% superannuation and leave loading
Location: UNSW Kensington Campus – Hybrid work arrangement (2-3 days onsite)

About UNSW

UNSW isn’t like other places you’ve worked. Yes, we’re a large organisation with a diverse and talented community, a community doing extraordinary things. Together, we are driven to be thoughtful, practical, and purposeful in all we do. Taking this combined approach is what makes our work matter. If you want a career where you can thrive, be challenged and do meaningful work, you’re in the right place.

Why Your Role Matters

UNSW's Education Domain is delivering strategic technology initiatives that shape how students and staff experience the University. As Project Manager, you will lead end-to-end delivery across the project lifecycle, from idea and discovery through design, implementation and post-implementation review.

You will translate objectives into practical project plans, establish the right cross-functional teams and create the governance, financial, risk and quality disciplines that keep delivery focused on scope, budget, timelines and outcomes.

Working across UNSW IT
and the broader University, you will bring together stakeholders, subject matter experts, product and process owners, vendors and delivery teams. Your ability to create clarity, manage dependencies and resolve competing priorities will be central to successful outcomes.

Reporting to the Lead Project Manager,
this is an opportunity to lead strategic projects and smaller initiatives while building a strong customer-centric delivery culture across a complex university environment.

Responsibilities Summary

Manage key project and initiative components across budget, risk, resources, change and quality from idea, discovery, design and delivery through to post-implementation review.
Develop and maintain practical project plans, milestones, delivery arrangements and assurance activities that keep teams aligned to scope, budget, schedule and intended outcomes.
Manage project dependencies, risks, issues, change requests and financials, ensuring appropriate controls, decisions and escalation pathways are in place.
Align projects and initiatives to UNSW governance pathways, applying a consistent and proven set of rules for planning, decision-making, assurance and reporting.
Lead effective communication and engagement with internal and external stakeholders, adapting information and recommendations to support timely decisions and sustained alignment.
Engage and coordinate staff assigned from IT and across the University, fostering a customer-centric delivery culture and supporting teams to achieve agreed scope, budget and timelines.
Manage vendor communications where applicable, working in partnership with Procurement, Legal, and Vendor and Commercial teams to support effective commercial outcomes.
Facilitate the interests and opinions of subject matter experts, product owners, process owners and key stakeholders, resolving competing needs so solutions meet stakeholder and business requirements.
Maintain high-quality project status reporting in Jira, Altus and other internal tools, at the Education Domain level and, where applicable, for the Portfolio Steering Committee.
Maintain strong quality assurance, demonstrate UNSW Values in Action and the Code of Conduct, and ensure psychosocial and physical health and safety risks are identified and controlled.

For more information regarding the responsibilities for this role, please refer to the Position Description at JOBS@UNSW.

Skills And Experience Summary

Relevant tertiary qualifications with subsequent relevant experience, or equivalent competence gained through education, training and experience.
Proven experience managing end-to-end IT projects or strategic initiatives, coordinating scope, schedule, budget, risk, resources, change and quality.
In-depth understanding of the project lifecycle and experience applying PRINCE2, PMBOK, Agile or other recognized project management methodologies.
Advanced written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to produce clear project information and engage effectively with a wide range of stakeholders.
Demonstrated success working collaboratively with people at different levels across a complex organization, including business, technical and delivery teams.
Excellent time management skills, with the judgment and initiative to respond to changing priorities, manage multiple tasks and meet competing deadlines.
Demonstrated problem-solving abilities, with the confidence to analyze issues, manage dependencies and recommend practical courses of action.
Knowledge of budgeting and resource allocation procedures, with the ability to monitor project financials and support sound delivery decisions.
Experience coordinating cross-functional project teams, vendors and subject matter experts in a customer-centric delivery environment.
An understanding of and commitment to UNSW's aims, objectives and values in action, together with relevant policies, guidelines and health and safety responsibilities.

Benefits and Culture:
People are at the core of everything we do. We recognise it is the contributions of our staff who make UNSW one of the best universities in Australia and the world. Our benefits include:

Career development opportunities
17% Superannuation contributions and additional leave loading payments
Additional 3 days of leave over Christmas period
Discounts and entitlements (retail, education, fitness)

How to Apply:
Submit your CV along with a cover letter addressing your suitability for the role via the application portal before 11:30pm on Friday, the 9th of October 2026.

A copy of the Position Description can be found on JOBS@UNSW.

Get in Touch:
For queries about the recruitment process, please contact the Talent Acquisition Partner, Ayla Kamal
on: ayla.kamal@unsw.edu.au

For queries about the role, please contact the Hiring Manager, Satish Patil
on: satish.patil@unsw.edu.au

Applications sent via email will not be accepted, please apply via the application portal.

Pre-Employment Checks

As part of our recruitment process candidates may be required to undergo pre-employment screening, which may include reference checks, qualification verification, right-to-work verification, and criminal history screening where relevant to the role.

UNSW is committed to evolving a culture that embraces equity and supports a diverse and inclusive community where everyone can participate fairly, in a safe and respectful environment. We welcome candidates from all backgrounds and encourage applications from people of diverse gender, sexual orientation, cultural and linguistic backgrounds, Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander background, people with disability and those with caring and family responsibilities. UNSW provides workplace adjustments for people with disability, and access to flexible work options for eligible staff.

Who We Are

We're powering a cleaner, brighter future.

Exelon is leading the energy transformation, and we're calling all problem solvers, innovators, community builders and change makers. Work with us to deliver solutions that make our diverse cities and communities stronger, healthier and more resilient.

We're powered by purpose-driven people like you who believe in being inclusive and creative, and value safety, innovation, integrity and community service. We are a Fortune 200 company, 20,000 colleagues strong serving more than 10.7 million customers at six energy companies -- Atlantic City Electric (ACE), Baltimore Gas and Electric (BGE), Commonwealth Edison (ComEd), Delmarva Power & Light (DPL), PECO Energy Company (PECO), and Potomac Electric Power Company (Pepco).

We're committed to creating an environment where every person can thrive. Our employee experience is grounded in four tenets that guide how we support our people: purposeful careers, growth opportunities, community impact, and support to thrive.

In our relentless pursuit of excellence, we elevate diverse voices, fresh perspectives and bold thinking. And since we know transforming the future of energy is hard work, we provide competitive compensation, incentives, excellent benefits and the opportunity to build a rewarding career.

Are you in?

Primary Purpose

This is a Project Manager role for utility/construction/engineering projects, NOT an IT PM role.

Manage (or support a Principal or Senior Project Manager with the management of) transmission, substation, distribution, and/or gas projects consisting of cross-functional teams that can involve multiple disciplines and multiple operating areas including contract resources. Responsible for managing or supporting the management of project's scope, schedule, budget, and safety performance of multiple projects and programs. Leads or supports project teams through business case / capital approval process, development and execution of project plans and project closeout. These projects have budgets that will typically range from $250K to $5 million. Position may be required to work extended hours for coverage during storms or other energy delivery emergencies.

Primary Duties

jobs.title: Senior Strategic Implementation Manager
jobs.description:
Kestra Financial is a wealth management platform dedicated to empowering independent financial professionals—including traditional and hybrid RIAs—to grow their businesses and deliver exceptional client service. We combine advanced business management technology with personalized consulting to provide unmatched scale, efficiency, and support. Our advisor-focused culture is built on innovation and advocacy, enabling advisors to offer comprehensive securities and investment advisory solutions to their clients

Lead with Purpose. Partner with Impact

Kestra Financial, a leading provider of wealth management platforms, technology solutions, and investment products empowering independent financial advisors and RIAs nationwide, is seeking a Senior Strategic Implementation Manager.

This role serves as a pivotal execution leader accountable for the disciplined delivery of Kestra Wealth Management’s highest-priority strategic initiatives in investment products and platform capabilities. You will drive the successful launch of new investment products and manage end-to-end launch campaigns while coordinating complex cross-functional projects spanning technology, compliance, business development, and operations.

By implementing and championing agile, Scrum-like cadences and robust portfolio governance practices, you will build transparency, predictability, and accountability across initiatives. Your leadership will ensure that strategic intent translates into measurable business outcomes—including accelerated advisor adoption, revenue contribution from new products, enhanced platform capabilities, and operational excellence.

This is a hands-on, high-impact role for a collaborative leader who thrives at the intersection of strategy, execution, and cross-functional influence in a dynamic, growth-oriented wealth management environment.

What You’ll Do:

Own the end-to-end governance and planning that results in successful delivery of priority investment product launches (e.g., alternative investment solutions, insurance products, or curated offerings) and strategic platform implementation initiatives (new advisory revenue vertical, investment program redesign, etc) from concept through post-launch optimization and benefits realization.
Lead the coordination and execution of comprehensive launch campaigns, aligning go-to-market activities including sales enablement, marketing communications, advisor training and onboarding programs, distribution strategy, and adoption tracking to drive rapid uptake and sustained engagement.
Establish and maintain a prioritized portfolio of strategic initiatives for Investment Platforms & Products; drive rigorous sequencing, capacity alignment, funding discipline, and proactive trade-off decisions (scope, timeline, resources, investment) aligned to Kestra’s business objectives and growth priorities.
Partner with Product Management to translate product strategy and roadmap into executable implementation plans with clear milestones, dependencies, and success criteria.
Support Wealth Management platform and product leads by facilitating high-performing cross-functional project teams and workstreams involving:
Technology: Platform development, data integrations (including MDM/medallion architectures), APIs, advisor portals/tools, and infrastructure enhancements.
Compliance & Legal: Product due diligence, regulatory reviews/approvals, disclosures, risk assessments, and ongoing product governance to ensure adherence to SEC, FINRA, fiduciary, and other requirements.
Business: Commercialization strategy, RIA/advisor engagement and feedback loops, distribution channel readiness, pricing/packaging, and P&L impact modeling.
Operations & Finance: Operational readiness, process design, financial tracking, and benefits measurement.
Map and manage complex dependencies, risks, and interdependencies across teams; proactively identify and remove blockers while fostering alignment and shared ownership in a matrixed environment.
Ensure every initiative incorporates appropriate compliance guardrails, risk controls, audit readiness, and change management from the start.
Design, implement, and continuously mature agile delivery operating models tailored to regulated investment product and platform initiatives. This includes establishing Scrum-like cadences (sprint planning, daily stand-ups, sprint reviews, retrospectives), Kanban for workflow transparency and flow optimization, and scaled frameworks (e.g., program-level planning or release management) for larger or interdependent efforts.
Stand up consistent governance rhythms and forums, including steering committees, launch readiness reviews/tollgates, dependency management sessions, risk reviews, and clear escalation paths to executive leadership.
Drive adoption of modern agile/project tools (Jira, Confluence, Azure DevOps, or equivalent) and best practices to improve delivery velocity, predictability, collaboration, and quality across technology and business teams.
Champion a shift toward iterative, outcome-focused delivery—balancing the need for structure and compliance in product launches with the speed and adaptability required in a competitive wealth tech landscape.
Build and operate a portfolio “control tower” capability: deliver timely, credible, decision-oriented reporting and dashboards on initiative status, milestones, risks/issues, dependencies, financial performance (budget vs. plan, ROI tracking), and leading indicators of business impact.
Define, track, and report on key business outcome metrics tied to each strategic initiative (e.g., new product net flows/AUM/revenue contribution, advisor adoption and usage rates, client/advisor satisfaction or NPS impact, reduction in time-to-market or launch cycle time, compliance adherence, platform feature utilization and engagement).
Proactively surface execution risks, capacity constraints, and recommended trade-offs to senior leadership; lead structured issue resolution, corrective action planning, and recovery efforts to protect delivery commitments and protect/enhance business results.
Prepare and present high-quality materials for executive leadership, steering committees, and governance forums; represent the delivery health and outlook of the Investment Platforms & Products portfolio with clarity and fact-based insights.
Instill a culture of genuine accountability—where teams own and are measured on the delivery of agreed business outcomes and value realization, not merely activity completion or milestone hitting.

What You Bring: 

Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Economics, Business, or Software Engineering.
2+ years experience in technical product management in an Agile environment.
5+ years of experience in wealth management, investment operations, or trading
3-5+ years of progressive leadership experience in strategic program/portfolio management, product implementation, launch execution, or enterprise transformation roles within wealth management, RIA platforms, investment product development, fintech, asset/wealth platforms, or similarly complex, regulated financial services environments.
Demonstrated success leading multiple end-to-end launches of investment products or major platform capabilities, including coordination across technology builds, compliance/regulatory approvals, and go-to-market execution
Direct experience with alternatives/private markets access, model portfolios, structured solutions, or advisor-facing technology platforms within a broker dealer organization is strongly preferred.
Track record of successfully implementing or significantly maturing agile delivery practices (Scrum, Kanban, SAFe, hybrid, or tailored approaches) in product development or regulated contexts, with quantifiable improvements in predictability, velocity, and time-to-value.

Certifications and Licenses:

Series 7 , 63 or 66 required within 2 years.
Series 65 preferred

Internal Application Policy:

Internal applicants must be in good standing and have a minimum of 1 year of service with Kestra. Internal applicants must also have a minimum of 1 year service in current role unless approved by EVP.

Benefits to support you:

Competitive pay and benefits with a large employer (over 1600 employees nationwide)
401(k), health insurance, and a competitive benefits package
Work in a supportive, collaborative environment committed to professional excellence
Help clients navigate meaningful financial decisions with confidence
Opportunities for training, development, and long-term growth within the firm
Tuition reimbursement for qualified expenses

Kestra Values:

Our Mission is Powering Financial Independence, enabling the growth and success of investing clients and the advisors who serve them. We do that by living our values: Serve, Make it Happen, and One team.

Join us in our mission to help customers accelerate business transformation with simple, powerful, and secure solutions.
The ideal candidate thrives in an innovative, fast-paced environment and is collaborative, accountable, ready, and empathetic. We’re looking for individuals who believe they can accomplish more as a team and create lasting growth for themselves and others. We hire based on attitude, competency, and commitment. Solarians are ready to advance our world-class solutions in a fast-paced environment and accept the challenge to lead with purpose. If you’re looking to build your career with an exceptional team, you’ve come to the right place. Join SolarWinds and grow with us!

About the Role

SolarWinds is seeking a Technical Project Manager to join our Platform Reliability organization. The team protects and improves the reliability of critical production systems while delivering a growing portfolio of infrastructure, resilience, security, compliance, cost optimization, automation, and developer enablement initiatives.
This role will bring dedicated program leadership to that portfolio. You will create clarity across complex, cross-functional work, establish predictable delivery, surface risks and dependencies early, and help engineering leaders and teams stay focused on reliability, resilience, automation, scalability, and operational risk reduction.

Facilitate prioritization and capacity discussions when multiple teams have competing requests, using business impact, customer impact, risk, company goals, and available SRE bandwidth to guide trade offs.
Maintain delivery rhythm through planning sessions, dependency reviews, risk and issue reviews, milestone tracking, and concise stakeholder updates.
Prepare executive status reporting focused on business impact, delivery confidence, decisions required, risks, and escalations - not just activity reporting.
Partner with SRE leadership to measure progress against reliability and operational excellence objectives.
Act as a trusted facilitator and escalation point who helps teams resolve ambiguity, make decisions, and maintain forward momentum.

What you’ll bring

4+ years of experience managing technical projects, programs, or portfolios in software, cloud infrastructure, platform engineering, DevOps, SRE, or a related environment.
Demonstrated success leading complex, cross-functional initiatives from early planning through delivery and operational adoption.
Understanding of software delivery and production operations, including infrastructure, cloud platforms, CI/CD, observability, incident management, change management, and reliability practices.
Experience coordinating work across engineering teams with shared dependencies, constrained capacity, and competing priorities.
Experience with Agile methodologies and tools, including Jira, Confluence, roadmap and portfolio management platforms, and similar delivery systems.
Strong risk management skills, including the ability to identify hidden dependencies, schedule threats, operational risks, and decision gaps early.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to tailor technical and delivery information for engineers, managers, executives, and non-technical stakeholders.
Experience building portfolio views, roadmaps, delivery plans, executive reports, operating cadences, and measurable outcome tracking.
Ability to facilitate difficult prioritization and trade-off conversations while maintaining trust and alignment across teams.
Technical fluency sufficient to understand architecture discussions, delivery constraints, operational risk, and engineering trade offs.
Strong organizational skills and attention to detail, paired with sound judgment about where process adds value.
A bias for ownership, action, transparency, and continuous improvement.

How you’ll measure success

In your first 90 days
Build relationships with SRE leadership, engineering partners, product, security, finance, and other key stakeholders.
Establish a current state view of the Production Engineering and Operations portfolio, including active initiatives, milestones, dependencies, risks, owners, and capacity constraints.
Document the operating cadence for intake, planning, prioritization, status reporting, and escalation.
Identify the highest impact opportunities to improve delivery predictability and reduce coordination overhead.

In your first 6 months
Establish a complete, prioritized portfolio with accountable owners and delivery milestones.
Improve visibility into cross-team dependencies, resource constraints, and schedule risks.
Improve alignment between engineering roadmaps and SRE capacity.
Demonstrate measurable progress against reliability and operational excellence goals.

Why join us

You’ll help shape how a critical SRE organization plans and delivers work that directly improves the reliability, security, efficiency, and customer experience of SolarWinds products. Your work will connect engineering strategy to execution and help turn complex, multi-team initiatives into durable operational outcomes.

jobs.title: Senior Strategic Implementation Manager
jobs.description:
Kestra Financial is a wealth management platform dedicated to empowering independent financial professionals—including traditional and hybrid RIAs—to grow their businesses and deliver exceptional client service. We combine advanced business management technology with personalized consulting to provide unmatched scale, efficiency, and support. Our advisor-focused culture is built on innovation and advocacy, enabling advisors to offer comprehensive securities and investment advisory solutions to their clients

Lead with Purpose. Partner with Impact

Kestra Financial, a leading provider of wealth management platforms, technology solutions, and investment products empowering independent financial advisors and RIAs nationwide, is seeking a Senior Strategic Implementation Manager.

This role serves as a pivotal execution leader accountable for the disciplined delivery of Kestra Wealth Management’s highest-priority strategic initiatives in investment products and platform capabilities. You will drive the successful launch of new investment products and manage end-to-end launch campaigns while coordinating complex cross-functional projects spanning technology, compliance, business development, and operations.

By implementing and championing agile, Scrum-like cadences and robust portfolio governance practices, you will build transparency, predictability, and accountability across initiatives. Your leadership will ensure that strategic intent translates into measurable business outcomes—including accelerated advisor adoption, revenue contribution from new products, enhanced platform capabilities, and operational excellence.

This is a hands-on, high-impact role for a collaborative leader who thrives at the intersection of strategy, execution, and cross-functional influence in a dynamic, growth-oriented wealth management environment.

What You’ll Do:

Own the end-to-end governance and planning that results in successful delivery of priority investment product launches (e.g., alternative investment solutions, insurance products, or curated offerings) and strategic platform implementation initiatives (new advisory revenue vertical, investment program redesign, etc) from concept through post-launch optimization and benefits realization.
Lead the coordination and execution of comprehensive launch campaigns, aligning go-to-market activities including sales enablement, marketing communications, advisor training and onboarding programs, distribution strategy, and adoption tracking to drive rapid uptake and sustained engagement.
Establish and maintain a prioritized portfolio of strategic initiatives for Investment Platforms & Products; drive rigorous sequencing, capacity alignment, funding discipline, and proactive trade-off decisions (scope, timeline, resources, investment) aligned to Kestra’s business objectives and growth priorities.
Partner with Product Management to translate product strategy and roadmap into executable implementation plans with clear milestones, dependencies, and success criteria.
Support Wealth Management platform and product leads by facilitating high-performing cross-functional project teams and workstreams involving:
Technology: Platform development, data integrations (including MDM/medallion architectures), APIs, advisor portals/tools, and infrastructure enhancements.
Compliance & Legal: Product due diligence, regulatory reviews/approvals, disclosures, risk assessments, and ongoing product governance to ensure adherence to SEC, FINRA, fiduciary, and other requirements.
Business: Commercialization strategy, RIA/advisor engagement and feedback loops, distribution channel readiness, pricing/packaging, and P&L impact modeling.
Operations & Finance: Operational readiness, process design, financial tracking, and benefits measurement.
Map and manage complex dependencies, risks, and interdependencies across teams; proactively identify and remove blockers while fostering alignment and shared ownership in a matrixed environment.
Ensure every initiative incorporates appropriate compliance guardrails, risk controls, audit readiness, and change management from the start.
Design, implement, and continuously mature agile delivery operating models tailored to regulated investment product and platform initiatives. This includes establishing Scrum-like cadences (sprint planning, daily stand-ups, sprint reviews, retrospectives), Kanban for workflow transparency and flow optimization, and scaled frameworks (e.g., program-level planning or release management) for larger or interdependent efforts.
Stand up consistent governance rhythms and forums, including steering committees, launch readiness reviews/tollgates, dependency management sessions, risk reviews, and clear escalation paths to executive leadership.
Drive adoption of modern agile/project tools (Jira, Confluence, Azure DevOps, or equivalent) and best practices to improve delivery velocity, predictability, collaboration, and quality across technology and business teams.
Champion a shift toward iterative, outcome-focused delivery—balancing the need for structure and compliance in product launches with the speed and adaptability required in a competitive wealth tech landscape.
Build and operate a portfolio “control tower” capability: deliver timely, credible, decision-oriented reporting and dashboards on initiative status, milestones, risks/issues, dependencies, financial performance (budget vs. plan, ROI tracking), and leading indicators of business impact.
Define, track, and report on key business outcome metrics tied to each strategic initiative (e.g., new product net flows/AUM/revenue contribution, advisor adoption and usage rates, client/advisor satisfaction or NPS impact, reduction in time-to-market or launch cycle time, compliance adherence, platform feature utilization and engagement).
Proactively surface execution risks, capacity constraints, and recommended trade-offs to senior leadership; lead structured issue resolution, corrective action planning, and recovery efforts to protect delivery commitments and protect/enhance business results.
Prepare and present high-quality materials for executive leadership, steering committees, and governance forums; represent the delivery health and outlook of the Investment Platforms & Products portfolio with clarity and fact-based insights.
Instill a culture of genuine accountability—where teams own and are measured on the delivery of agreed business outcomes and value realization, not merely activity completion or milestone hitting.

What You Bring: 

Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Economics, Business, or Software Engineering.
2+ years experience in technical product management in an Agile environment.
5+ years of experience in wealth management, investment operations, or trading
3-5+ years of progressive leadership experience in strategic program/portfolio management, product implementation, launch execution, or enterprise transformation roles within wealth management, RIA platforms, investment product development, fintech, asset/wealth platforms, or similarly complex, regulated financial services environments.
Demonstrated success leading multiple end-to-end launches of investment products or major platform capabilities, including coordination across technology builds, compliance/regulatory approvals, and go-to-market execution
Direct experience with alternatives/private markets access, model portfolios, structured solutions, or advisor-facing technology platforms within a broker dealer organization is strongly preferred.
Track record of successfully implementing or significantly maturing agile delivery practices (Scrum, Kanban, SAFe, hybrid, or tailored approaches) in product development or regulated contexts, with quantifiable improvements in predictability, velocity, and time-to-value.

Certifications and Licenses:

Series 7 , 63 or 66 required within 2 years.
Series 65 preferred

Internal Application Policy:

Internal applicants must be in good standing and have a minimum of 1 year of service with Kestra. Internal applicants must also have a minimum of 1 year service in current role unless approved by EVP.

Benefits to support you:

Competitive pay and benefits with a large employer (over 1600 employees nationwide)
401(k), health insurance, and a competitive benefits package
Work in a supportive, collaborative environment committed to professional excellence
Help clients navigate meaningful financial decisions with confidence
Opportunities for training, development, and long-term growth within the firm
Tuition reimbursement for qualified expenses

Kestra Values:

Our Mission is Powering Financial Independence, enabling the growth and success of investing clients and the advisors who serve them. We do that by living our values: Serve, Make it Happen, and One team.

Explore Life at Kestra

Kestra Holdings Website: https://www.kestrafinancial.com/

Careers Portal: https://jobs.dayforcehcm.com/en-US/kestra/KESTRACAREERSITE

LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/company/kestra-financial

Apply Today

Lead with purpose. Apply now and help shape the future of Kestra.

You acknowledge that if hired, Kestra Financial, Inc. may, obtain and use background information concerning your credit, character, general reputation, personal characteristics, work habits, performance and experience for evaluation for your potential employment.

jobs.title: Vigilant IT Security Manager - Portugal/Poland (Remote)
jobs.description:
This is not an offshoring back-office job for an international company. You will be a key player in our globally distributed team.

We’re searching for a Vigilant IT Security Manager to help us get our IT security systems up to spec, secure our networks and keep the vital organs of our team working! If you like solving complex business problems , and are experienced in all things IT security , we need you!

Read on!

(this will be a long write up but we like to give you all the details before you spend your time applying)

___________________________________________________________

We are Laminar Projects!

We are an award winning consultancy that implements technology to improve the delivery of complex construction projects. Improving construction strengthens the very foundation of human civilisation. ( Watch our short film about it )

We also have a separate product team, Shape Construction, that takes the deep understanding of the projects we work on to develop construction management software products.

The core of all this is our true secret sauce; people. We only recruit kind and authentic people who are fast learners. We are deeply focused on designing a new type of place that is optimised for the flourishing of the people in the team first and foremost. This approach has allowed us to grow from just 2 people in 2017 to over 170 today and we are still very much at the beginning! Joining us isn’t just some “job,” we challenge you to be your best self in all aspects of life.

Our vision is designed to align how we operate with the fundamental aspects that enable anyone to have a fulfilled life:

Connects us with meaningful relationships
Inspires us to develop ourselves to become better humans
Empowers us to pursue our own learning adventures

4 core values for a good life

We believe a life of human flourishing is all about meaningful relationships with others and challenging yourself to create a positive impact. Our four core values are grow yourself, care about people, execute to greatness and build civilisation. This philosophy goes much deeper and you can see more on our website.

W e are achieving this vision through the following two missions:

To fully digitise the construction of human civilisation
To create a new type of organisation that enables human flourishing while delivering a huge positive impact on society

___________________________________________________________

The Role

Purpose of the role

As the IT Security Manager at Laminar, you will play a pivotal role in managing our IT security systems, identifying and closing any cybersecurity risk we hold, whilst also ensuring the smooth operation and development of the IT function. Your primary focus will be on maturing our security systems, ensuring adherence to industry standards, regulatory requirements, and best practices, particularly in alignment with relevant accreditations such as ISO 27001 and SOC2. Additionally, you will be responsible for all Laminar’s IT related policy and business rules, the managing of software, hardware and infrastructure management, and establishing SLAs for user support.

Team

Our IT team is the first port of call when things go wrong, and the first to spot trouble before it does. From fixing the everyday snags to keeping systems, networks, and data running securely behind the scenes, they keep the business moving so everyone else can get on with their work . Your leadership and coordination will ensure that the IT team continues to deliver high quality support for all departments within Laminar.

Your top three objectives

Identify and mitigate IT security risks and close gaps in our systems.
Ensure compliance with ISO 27001 and SOC2 standards and regulations.
Develop and maintain a high-performing IT department.

Your Top Five Responsibilities

Lead strategic IT projects: Drive critical initiatives to ensure we proactively identify and close any security system risks whilst remaining compliant with ISO 27001 standards, regulations, and audit compliance .
General IT Management: Including responsibility for and oversight of software, hardware and infrastructure management.
Develop and enforce policies: Create and implement robust IT policies, procedures, and controls.
Collaborate across teams: Align IT efforts with our goals through close collaboration with diverse teams and stakeholders, ensuring effective support and product ownership for core applications.
Functional Leadership and promoting culture: Offer leadership on IT security, risk management, and compliance, fostering a culture of excellence and accountability, while also optimizing tools for support and ensuring efficient tech support across Laminar.

Your Capabilities

You will be a proven IT operations leader who knows how to switch between being a project manager, leader, communicator, researcher and doer, to make things better.

As a candidate, who should have:

Must-Have

Mastery : Strong understanding of IT security systems, where vulnerabilities are and how to close those gaps. You should have experience across both Microsoft and Google environments. You should also understand ISO 27001 standards, regulatory requirements, and industry best practices, along with proficiency in risk management, compliance management, and audit processes.
Communication : Precise and structured communicator, both written and verbal, in English.
Leadership : Ability to effectively manage teams and projects simultaneously, prioritize tasks effectively, and collaborating with cross-functional teams and stakeholders.
Impact : A track record of making workplaces better beyond just doing the basics.

Nice to Have

Mastery: Certifications such as CISSP, CISM, or CISA and knowledge of IT governance frameworks such as COBIT or ITIL is desirable.
Communication: Precise and structured communicator both written and verbal
Leadership: A proven leader, coach or developer of teams.
Impact: A track record of implementing scalable and repeatable solutions in projects and teams that had a significant positive impact on support desk operations, software/tech support, and IT infrastructure management.

Laminar isn’t the place for you if any of the following is true:

You want an easy, chilled-out role without much challenge
You like to be the smartest person in the room
You don’t like continuously receiving honest candid feedback
You prefer to do your own thing rather than work with a team

___________________________________________________________

Benefits

The Standard Stuff

Health Insurance Scheme. Comprehensive private health coverage - for you and your family. Because your well-being is our priority
Pension Scheme. A competitive plan to help you plan for the long term - plus salary sacrifice options available to maximize your savings
Bonus Scheme. As a permanent member of the team, you’ll share in our success. Our annual bonus is designed to reward both the now and the future - with a flexible mix of cash and high-growth equity that you choose. Bonuses are discretionary and based on performance
Professional body membership. One fee covered per year - so you can stay connected to your field and develop your craft
Cycle to Work Scheme. A tax-efficient way to get wheels - and do your bit for the environment

The Life-Changing Stuff

( Get to know us better by watching a few more of our videos. )

Core values for a good life

A life of human flourishing is all about meaningful relationships and challenging yourself to create a positive impact, so our values reflect the four levels of relationships that each of us has:

Grow yourself – your relationship with yourself
Care about people – your relationship with others around you
Execute to greatness – your relationship with your team
Build civilisation – your relationship with humanity and the world

We enshrined our values in our vision:

We exist so that everyone in our team can flourish in a high-impact community that:

Connects us with meaningful relationships
Inspires us to develop ourselves to become better humans
Empowers us to pursue our own learning adventures

By first doing this, we can achieve the highest levels of value for the world.

And enable the achievement of our vision through our two missions:

To fully digitalise the construction of human civilisation
To create a new type of organisation that enables human flourishing while delivering a huge positive impact on society

____________________________________________________

The Role

Purpose of the role

You will improve how some of the world’s most interesting and complex construction projects are run. You’ll do this by deploying Oracle Construction Systems, applying your technical expertise alongside strong people and project controls skills. The goal is to make life easier for everyone involved in project and programme delivery, ensuring projects are delivered on time and on budget.

We work with various systems, but for this role, we are specifically looking for expertise in deploying Oracle Primavera Cloud (OPC) and/or Primavera Unifier.

Experience in planning, along with a strong command of platforms such as Oracle Primavera P6, Aconex, and Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI), would be a valuable asset. You’ll not only lead implementation projects but also lead software sales by demonstrating the value of these tools to potential clients. Across all these areas, your excellent communication skills will be key.

You’ll join a rapidly growing team responsible for sales and implementation of the project controls systems. There will be opportunities to manage people, lead projects, drive system sales, develop internal processes, and take on key business development activities.

Adaptability is key. Given our rapid growth, your focus might shift from Oracle systems to project controls, planning and digital transformation projects. If you're open to that kind of flexibility, this role is for you!

Team

This role is part of our Project Management Consultancy which focuses on:

Understanding what the real problems of projects are
Implementing the best solutions to those problems
Developing scalable best practices, tools and technology

More specifically you will join the Integrated Project Controls Systems (IPCS) team who are industry leaders in improving delivery of complex projects through deployment of the most suitable software on the market.

Your top three objectives

To make construction projects deliver to near perfection
To create scalable and repeatable solutions to common problems
To develop yourself and everyone around you

Your Top 5 Responsibilities

Own the implementation plan: Own the system implementation plan and drive software configuration and adoption to achieve desired outcomes. We believe in your ability to assess the situation and commit to what is achievable.
Develop impactful solutions: Leverage your planning and project controls expertise to design and configure scalable, optimized and fit-for-purpose solutions on Oracle systems.
Manage people and process: While great technical solutions are important, successfully deploying them to a large user base requires more than just a good config. Engaging all relevant stakeholders is key, ensuring they understand that the new processes and tools are designed to make their lives easier.
Drive system sales: Identify leads and opportunities to deploy systems across new and existing clients. Support pre-sales activities by showcasing software capabilities and building compelling prototypes.
Develop everyone: Maximise the development of your team personally and professionally and educate our clients to improve as well. (even if you are junior you can help your leader develop too!)

Your Capabilities

We are looking for a self-driven individual who can leverage their project controls expertise to configure and deploy flagship Oracle Construction systems. We’re seeking someone with strong industry experience, a solid reputation, and an established network that can be leveraged to help drive our sales pipeline.

At Laminar, self-development is at the heart of what we do. If you are open to feedback, eager to learn, and motivated by a continuous growth journey that supports both personal and professional development, then keep reading; this role might be what you’re looking for.

What matters most to us is your attitude, drive, and people skills. If you’ve got a knack for configuring Oracle systems and are a natural communicator who easily builds strong relationships with project stakeholders and potential clients, this role could be perfect for you. Most importantly, you should enjoy the work and be excited to learn and grow along the way.

As a candidate, you should have:

Must-Have
(The fundamentals)

Mastery: Experience in sales and implementation of Oracle Systems in the construction industry
Communication: Proficient communicator in written and verbal English, with ability to convey messages with clarity, motivate teams and lead meetings effectively. Kind and empathetic active listener, capable of giving and receiving constructive feedback.
Leadership: Proactively take ownership of tasks, inspire others through thoughtful questions, and challenge the team to think critically and stay on track
Impact: A track record of making projects and organisations better beyond just doing the basics

Nice to Have
(If you don’t have it now you will be trained after joining)

Mastery: Planning in Primavera P6, Analytics in Power BI, Cost Management, Project Management.
Communication: The charisma, influence and presence to get construction people to do new things and take the best approach
Leadership: A proven leader/coach/developer of teams or teams of teams
Impact: A track record of implementing scalable and repeatable solutions in projects and organisations that had a significant positive impact

Laminar isn’t the place for you if any of the following is true:

You want an easy, chilled-out role without much challenge
You like to be the smartest person in the room
You don’t like continuously receiving honest candid feedback
You prefer to do your own thing rather than work with a team

____________________________________________________

Frequently Asked Questions

What kinds of projects would I be working on?

It’s common for people to be exposed to several projects in their first year with us. You’ll work on some of the most complex and interesting environments in the world. We’ve delivered over 100 data centres internationally, many of them fast-tracked and multi-package. Our teams have supported flagship infrastructure programmes like HS2 through integrated planning and digital delivery, contributed to over $30bn in power generation and transmission projects, and played a key role in the development of high-containment labs and R&D campuses for some of the world’s most advanced industrial and life sciences clients. You might find yourself working in sectors such as data centres
, infrastructure
(including defense, rail, and highways), high tech
(such as advanced manufacturing, pharmaceuticals, and semiconductors), or complex building projects
. These aren’t hands-off assignments. They’re dynamic, hands-on environments designed for people who want to be challenged. We bring back the lessons from every project to help our team grow and deliver the highest levels of value. ( Check out our case stories .)

Who are our clients?

Major owners/operators and main contractors with project values between £1m and £1bn+ globally.

Where would I be working?

One week you might be working from home. The next, you might travel to the site to meet the construction teams and help organise them. Maybe you’ll pop into our London office for a workshop or a beer. Maybe you’ll fly out to exotic (and sometimes not!) locations in Europe or the Middle East to visit clients. It really depends on what you want to get involved in and what fits with your life.

How does what I do connect with the long-term impact on the construction industry?

You’re tasked with understanding and solving common problems. We don’t want to reinvent the wheel every time, so you’ll be responsible for documenting new solutions and evolving ones we’ve developed. This goes into our knowledge repository, which we’re going to open source to the industry.

The knowledge you capture will be used by us to build new products. You’ll constantly test those products in the field, so we can rapidly iterate and improve them for anyone in the industry to use.
