new_jobs.title: Senior Strategic Implementation Manager
new_jobs.description:
Kestra Financial is a wealth management platform dedicated to empowering independent financial professionals—including traditional and hybrid RIAs—to grow their businesses and deliver exceptional client service. We combine advanced business management technology with personalized consulting to provide unmatched scale, efficiency, and support. Our advisor-focused culture is built on innovation and advocacy, enabling advisors to offer comprehensive securities and investment advisory solutions to their clients

Lead with Purpose. Partner with Impact

Kestra Financial, a leading provider of wealth management platforms, technology solutions, and investment products empowering independent financial advisors and RIAs nationwide, is seeking a Senior Strategic Implementation Manager.

This role serves as a pivotal execution leader accountable for the disciplined delivery of Kestra Wealth Management’s highest-priority strategic initiatives in investment products and platform capabilities. You will drive the successful launch of new investment products and manage end-to-end launch campaigns while coordinating complex cross-functional projects spanning technology, compliance, business development, and operations.

By implementing and championing agile, Scrum-like cadences and robust portfolio governance practices, you will build transparency, predictability, and accountability across initiatives. Your leadership will ensure that strategic intent translates into measurable business outcomes—including accelerated advisor adoption, revenue contribution from new products, enhanced platform capabilities, and operational excellence.

This is a hands-on, high-impact role for a collaborative leader who thrives at the intersection of strategy, execution, and cross-functional influence in a dynamic, growth-oriented wealth management environment.

What You’ll Do:

Own the end-to-end governance and planning that results in successful delivery of priority investment product launches (e.g., alternative investment solutions, insurance products, or curated offerings) and strategic platform implementation initiatives (new advisory revenue vertical, investment program redesign, etc) from concept through post-launch optimization and benefits realization.
Lead the coordination and execution of comprehensive launch campaigns, aligning go-to-market activities including sales enablement, marketing communications, advisor training and onboarding programs, distribution strategy, and adoption tracking to drive rapid uptake and sustained engagement.
Establish and maintain a prioritized portfolio of strategic initiatives for Investment Platforms & Products; drive rigorous sequencing, capacity alignment, funding discipline, and proactive trade-off decisions (scope, timeline, resources, investment) aligned to Kestra’s business objectives and growth priorities.
Partner with Product Management to translate product strategy and roadmap into executable implementation plans with clear milestones, dependencies, and success criteria.
Support Wealth Management platform and product leads by facilitating high-performing cross-functional project teams and workstreams involving:
Technology: Platform development, data integrations (including MDM/medallion architectures), APIs, advisor portals/tools, and infrastructure enhancements.
Compliance & Legal: Product due diligence, regulatory reviews/approvals, disclosures, risk assessments, and ongoing product governance to ensure adherence to SEC, FINRA, fiduciary, and other requirements.
Business: Commercialization strategy, RIA/advisor engagement and feedback loops, distribution channel readiness, pricing/packaging, and P&L impact modeling.
Operations & Finance: Operational readiness, process design, financial tracking, and benefits measurement.
Map and manage complex dependencies, risks, and interdependencies across teams; proactively identify and remove blockers while fostering alignment and shared ownership in a matrixed environment.
Ensure every initiative incorporates appropriate compliance guardrails, risk controls, audit readiness, and change management from the start.
Design, implement, and continuously mature agile delivery operating models tailored to regulated investment product and platform initiatives. This includes establishing Scrum-like cadences (sprint planning, daily stand-ups, sprint reviews, retrospectives), Kanban for workflow transparency and flow optimization, and scaled frameworks (e.g., program-level planning or release management) for larger or interdependent efforts.
Stand up consistent governance rhythms and forums, including steering committees, launch readiness reviews/tollgates, dependency management sessions, risk reviews, and clear escalation paths to executive leadership.
Drive adoption of modern agile/project tools (Jira, Confluence, Azure DevOps, or equivalent) and best practices to improve delivery velocity, predictability, collaboration, and quality across technology and business teams.
Champion a shift toward iterative, outcome-focused delivery—balancing the need for structure and compliance in product launches with the speed and adaptability required in a competitive wealth tech landscape.
Build and operate a portfolio “control tower” capability: deliver timely, credible, decision-oriented reporting and dashboards on initiative status, milestones, risks/issues, dependencies, financial performance (budget vs. plan, ROI tracking), and leading indicators of business impact.
Define, track, and report on key business outcome metrics tied to each strategic initiative (e.g., new product net flows/AUM/revenue contribution, advisor adoption and usage rates, client/advisor satisfaction or NPS impact, reduction in time-to-market or launch cycle time, compliance adherence, platform feature utilization and engagement).
Proactively surface execution risks, capacity constraints, and recommended trade-offs to senior leadership; lead structured issue resolution, corrective action planning, and recovery efforts to protect delivery commitments and protect/enhance business results.
Prepare and present high-quality materials for executive leadership, steering committees, and governance forums; represent the delivery health and outlook of the Investment Platforms & Products portfolio with clarity and fact-based insights.
Instill a culture of genuine accountability—where teams own and are measured on the delivery of agreed business outcomes and value realization, not merely activity completion or milestone hitting.

What You Bring: 

Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Economics, Business, or Software Engineering.
2+ years experience in technical product management in an Agile environment.
5+ years of experience in wealth management, investment operations, or trading
3-5+ years of progressive leadership experience in strategic program/portfolio management, product implementation, launch execution, or enterprise transformation roles within wealth management, RIA platforms, investment product development, fintech, asset/wealth platforms, or similarly complex, regulated financial services environments.
Demonstrated success leading multiple end-to-end launches of investment products or major platform capabilities, including coordination across technology builds, compliance/regulatory approvals, and go-to-market execution
Direct experience with alternatives/private markets access, model portfolios, structured solutions, or advisor-facing technology platforms within a broker dealer organization is strongly preferred.
Track record of successfully implementing or significantly maturing agile delivery practices (Scrum, Kanban, SAFe, hybrid, or tailored approaches) in product development or regulated contexts, with quantifiable improvements in predictability, velocity, and time-to-value.

Certifications and Licenses:

Series 7 , 63 or 66 required within 2 years.
Series 65 preferred

Internal Application Policy:

Internal applicants must be in good standing and have a minimum of 1 year of service with Kestra. Internal applicants must also have a minimum of 1 year service in current role unless approved by EVP.

Benefits to support you:

Competitive pay and benefits with a large employer (over 1600 employees nationwide)
401(k), health insurance, and a competitive benefits package
Work in a supportive, collaborative environment committed to professional excellence
Help clients navigate meaningful financial decisions with confidence
Opportunities for training, development, and long-term growth within the firm
Tuition reimbursement for qualified expenses

Kestra Values:

Our Mission is Powering Financial Independence, enabling the growth and success of investing clients and the advisors who serve them. We do that by living our values: Serve, Make it Happen, and One team.

Careers Portal: https://jobs.dayforcehcm.com/en-US/kestra/KESTRACAREERSITE

LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/company/kestra-financial

Apply Today

Lead with purpose. Apply now and help shape the future of Kestra.

to lead complex manufacturing and automation initiatives across multiple international locations while helping shape the future of our engineering organization.

In this highly visible role, you will partner with executive leadership, mentor and develop the next generation of engineers, and oversee multimillion-dollar projects that advance innovation, efficiency, and growth across our global operations.

This role is on-site 5 days a week
at our Chicago location with domestic and international travel approximately up to 60%
of the time.

What You’ll Do

Major involvement with the development, management and execution of the International Capital budget across multiple facilities in UK, Europe, India, China, Thailand, Philippines, Australia and New Zealand.
Manages full life cycle capital projects from concept to feasibility to installation, start-up and final handover. Develops scope of work, preliminary budgets, detailed cost estimates, equipment specifications, drawings, bid documents, bid tabulations from vendor proposals and schedules for NWF management approval.
Oversees the project design and development to ensure that the project delivers all project objectives on time, and within the approved capital budget as effectively and efficiently as possible.

Research new methodologies, tools, and market trends to ensure engineering designs and operations meet evolving industry standards.

What You Bring

Bachelor’s Degree in Engineering, (Chemical, Electrical or Mechanical)
Required to travel – up to 60% with both domestic and international travel (pending project needs)
12+ years of progressive project engineering and capital project management experience within the food manufacturing industry.
Proficiency in CAD software, Project Management software, and Microsoft 365
Ability to simultaneously manage multiple projects in a fast-paced environment across multiple time zones and cultures.
Strong technical acumen in the areas of Factory Floor Automation, Engineering Design Review, Process and Packaging Systems, Safety/Compliance & Risk Mitigation.
Financial proficiency in cost forecasting, negotiating, scope definition, and monitoring project budgets.
Fundamental understanding of Operational Technology [OT] environments, including industrial network infrastructure, Industrial Control Systems [ICS], SCADA, PLCs, Manufacturing Execution systems [MES], Industrial IoT, and Industry 4.0 technologies.
Exceptional stakeholder management, communication, and influence skills, with the ability to communicate succinctly and effectively with executive leadership.
Experience in Food Manufacturing, preferably with Experience in Industrial Baking, Dry Blending, and/or QSR sauces, dressings and condiments.

Preferred

Demonstrated ability to lead projects effectively across multiple countries, cultures, business functions, and regulatory environments.
PMP, PRINCE2, or equivalent certification
Experience delivering projects with EPC contract management method
Working knowledge of construction contracts (AIA, DBIA, FIDIC, etc.)

Work Environment

General Office and Manufacturing plant setting.
Periodic exposure to (1) a loud environment, (2) airborne particles with stronger odors associated with spicy food ingredients, (3) cold, hot, wet, and humid conditions, (4) walking and standing on concrete, (5) climbing steps, ladders, (6) standing on elevated surfaces (on occasions greater than 50’).
Fast-paced environment

Compensation Range:
$130,000 -$175,000 + Bonus Eligibility

Applicants for this position must be currently authorized to work in the United States on a full-time basis. Newly Weds Foods will not sponsor applicants for this position for work visas.

Why Join Newly Weds Foods?

Established, stable company with a long history and strong industry reputation
Long-tenured team members who reflect our supportive and collaborative culture
Opportunity to own and grow your territory with real impact on business success
Exposure to innovative food solutions and a diverse product portfolio
Collaborative environment with cross-functional support
Career growth opportunities within a global organization

new_jobs.title: Vigilant IT Security Manager - Portugal/Poland (Remote)
new_jobs.description:
This is not an offshoring back-office job for an international company. You will be a key player in our globally distributed team.

We’re searching for a Vigilant IT Security Manager to help us get our IT security systems up to spec, secure our networks and keep the vital organs of our team working! If you like solving complex business problems , and are experienced in all things IT security , we need you!

Read on!

(this will be a long write up but we like to give you all the details before you spend your time applying)

___________________________________________________________

We are Laminar Projects!

We are an award winning consultancy that implements technology to improve the delivery of complex construction projects. Improving construction strengthens the very foundation of human civilisation. ( Watch our short film about it )

We also have a separate product team, Shape Construction, that takes the deep understanding of the projects we work on to develop construction management software products.

The core of all this is our true secret sauce; people. We only recruit kind and authentic people who are fast learners. We are deeply focused on designing a new type of place that is optimised for the flourishing of the people in the team first and foremost. This approach has allowed us to grow from just 2 people in 2017 to over 170 today and we are still very much at the beginning! Joining us isn’t just some “job,” we challenge you to be your best self in all aspects of life.

Our vision is designed to align how we operate with the fundamental aspects that enable anyone to have a fulfilled life:

Connects us with meaningful relationships
Inspires us to develop ourselves to become better humans
Empowers us to pursue our own learning adventures

4 core values for a good life

We believe a life of human flourishing is all about meaningful relationships with others and challenging yourself to create a positive impact. Our four core values are grow yourself, care about people, execute to greatness and build civilisation. This philosophy goes much deeper and you can see more on our website.

W e are achieving this vision through the following two missions:

To fully digitise the construction of human civilisation
To create a new type of organisation that enables human flourishing while delivering a huge positive impact on society

___________________________________________________________

The Role

Purpose of the role

As the IT Security Manager at Laminar, you will play a pivotal role in managing our IT security systems, identifying and closing any cybersecurity risk we hold, whilst also ensuring the smooth operation and development of the IT function. Your primary focus will be on maturing our security systems, ensuring adherence to industry standards, regulatory requirements, and best practices, particularly in alignment with relevant accreditations such as ISO 27001 and SOC2. Additionally, you will be responsible for all Laminar’s IT related policy and business rules, the managing of software, hardware and infrastructure management, and establishing SLAs for user support.

Team

Our IT team is the first port of call when things go wrong, and the first to spot trouble before it does. From fixing the everyday snags to keeping systems, networks, and data running securely behind the scenes, they keep the business moving so everyone else can get on with their work . Your leadership and coordination will ensure that the IT team continues to deliver high quality support for all departments within Laminar.

Your top three objectives

Identify and mitigate IT security risks and close gaps in our systems.
Ensure compliance with ISO 27001 and SOC2 standards and regulations.
Develop and maintain a high-performing IT department.

Your Top Five Responsibilities

Lead strategic IT projects: Drive critical initiatives to ensure we proactively identify and close any security system risks whilst remaining compliant with ISO 27001 standards, regulations, and audit compliance .
General IT Management: Including responsibility for and oversight of software, hardware and infrastructure management.
Develop and enforce policies: Create and implement robust IT policies, procedures, and controls.
Collaborate across teams: Align IT efforts with our goals through close collaboration with diverse teams and stakeholders, ensuring effective support and product ownership for core applications.
Functional Leadership and promoting culture: Offer leadership on IT security, risk management, and compliance, fostering a culture of excellence and accountability, while also optimizing tools for support and ensuring efficient tech support across Laminar.

Your Capabilities

You will be a proven IT operations leader who knows how to switch between being a project manager, leader, communicator, researcher and doer, to make things better.

As a candidate, who should have:

Must-Have

Mastery : Strong understanding of IT security systems, where vulnerabilities are and how to close those gaps. You should have experience across both Microsoft and Google environments. You should also understand ISO 27001 standards, regulatory requirements, and industry best practices, along with proficiency in risk management, compliance management, and audit processes.
Communication : Precise and structured communicator, both written and verbal, in English.
Leadership : Ability to effectively manage teams and projects simultaneously, prioritize tasks effectively, and collaborating with cross-functional teams and stakeholders.
Impact : A track record of making workplaces better beyond just doing the basics.

Nice to Have

Mastery: Certifications such as CISSP, CISM, or CISA and knowledge of IT governance frameworks such as COBIT or ITIL is desirable.
Communication: Precise and structured communicator both written and verbal
Leadership: A proven leader, coach or developer of teams.
Impact: A track record of implementing scalable and repeatable solutions in projects and teams that had a significant positive impact on support desk operations, software/tech support, and IT infrastructure management.

Laminar isn’t the place for you if any of the following is true:

You want an easy, chilled-out role without much challenge
You like to be the smartest person in the room
You don’t like continuously receiving honest candid feedback
You prefer to do your own thing rather than work with a team

___________________________________________________________

Benefits

The Standard Stuff

Health Insurance Scheme. Comprehensive private health coverage - for you and your family. Because your well-being is our priority
Pension Scheme. A competitive plan to help you plan for the long term - plus salary sacrifice options available to maximize your savings
Bonus Scheme. As a permanent member of the team, you’ll share in our success. Our annual bonus is designed to reward both the now and the future - with a flexible mix of cash and high-growth equity that you choose. Bonuses are discretionary and based on performance
Professional body membership. One fee covered per year - so you can stay connected to your field and develop your craft
Cycle to Work Scheme. A tax-efficient way to get wheels - and do your bit for the environment

The Life-Changing Stuff

Flexibility: Getting things done is what really matters, not what time of day you do it. That means you don’t have to ask permission for things like picking up your kids or going to the doctor, just keep your team in the loop if you think they will be affected.
Grow your whole self: Our leaders are more like coaches and one of our main objectives is to give 5 years’ worth of learning and development for every 1 year with us. You have a coach, mentor, well-being therapist and a development-orientated environment: That’s literally what our vision is all about and the primary reason Laminar exists.
Be surrounded by the best: We only hire and retain the very best people. You might be used to being the smartest in the room but that won’t be the case in Laminar. You will be surrounded by people you can learn from. We are 100% meritocratic so fast progression is the norm. You will be supported to excel in whichever areas you are most interested in! With Laminar, development is unbounded
Long-term impact: We are focused on solving the biggest issues in construction project delivery in a way that can spread and outlast us

___________________________________________________________

Important! Applying properly

We get thousands of applications so please write us a letter as part of your application explaining:

Why do you want to join us?
If you joined, where do you think you could make the most impact and how?

We aren't a giant faceless corporation; we really care about the people who want to join our team so all applications will be read thoroughly by our key leaders. In terms of application, we usually start with an intro call to tell you what we are all about in a casual conversation. That helps you to know us a bit better and tell us a bit about yourself.

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

Communication: Precise and structured communicator both written and verbal

If you’re looking for a career that will help you stand out, join HSBC and fulfil your potential. Whether you want a career that could take you to the top, or simply take you in an exciting new direction, HSBC offers opportunities, support and rewards that will take you further.

GCOO change teams are at the center of the bank, working between Lines of Businesses and Functions on the highest profile programme from Strategy & design to delivery and change adoption.
Change Managers manage change end-to-end through projects which are established to deliver a specific outcome, on time and on budget. Projects may be stand alone or part of a Programme.

new_jobs.title: Influential Oracle Construction Sales and Implementation Manager (UK)
new_jobs.description:
Do you get a thrill from using technology to make construction projects run like a well-oiled machine?

Are you a natural communicator that knows how to establish strong customer relationships?

Have you survived the rollercoaster of large-scale system implementation, managed to conquer the chaos, and somehow still want to continue on this journey?

Let’s talk!

____________________________________________________

We are Laminar Projects!

If you’ve already heard about us, you’re probably reading this because you’re tired of the typical, chaotic ways of doing things in construction. But in case you haven’t, we’re a high-end project management consultancy and tech developer with a focus on upgrading the way construction projects are delivered.

Improving construction strengthens the very foundation of human civilisation. ( Check out our short film about it. )

We bring transparency and control to projects through a pragmatic mix of the latest tech, our own processes, and a big dose of common sense. We then take our deep understanding of these projects and we invest heavily into developing the digital solutions that anyone can use to deliver their projects better. ( Check out Shape, our construction management tech, to see what we’re doing.)

The core of all this is our true secret sauce: our people. We only recruit the very best, both in capability and personality. We’re deeply focused on designing a new type of organisation that’s optimised for the flourishing of the people in the team first and foremost. People who join us develop fast as a whole person in ways they never imagined. ( Read more about our vision and missions .)

This approach has allowed us to grow from just two people in 2017 to over 220 today. We have a stable, repeat client base across infrastructure and complex building projects in the UK and internationally, and we’re still growing fast. Joining us isn’t just some “job”. It’s a transformative educational experience. We challenge you to be your best self in all aspects of life. There are many diverse and interesting challenges available. It’s up to you to guide yourself into whichever areas you’re most interested – we’ll enable it.

( Get to know us better by watching a few more of our videos. )

Core values for a good life

A life of human flourishing is all about meaningful relationships and challenging yourself to create a positive impact, so our values reflect the four levels of relationships that each of us has:

Grow yourself – your relationship with yourself
Care about people – your relationship with others around you
Execute to greatness – your relationship with your team
Build civilisation – your relationship with humanity and the world

We enshrined our values in our vision:

We exist so that everyone in our team can flourish in a high-impact community that:

Connects us with meaningful relationships
Inspires us to develop ourselves to become better humans
Empowers us to pursue our own learning adventures

By first doing this, we can achieve the highest levels of value for the world.

And enable the achievement of our vision through our two missions:

To fully digitalise the construction of human civilisation
To create a new type of organisation that enables human flourishing while delivering a huge positive impact on society

____________________________________________________

The Role

Purpose of the role

You will improve how some of the world’s most interesting and complex construction projects are run. You’ll do this by deploying Oracle Construction Systems, applying your technical expertise alongside strong people and project controls skills. The goal is to make life easier for everyone involved in project and programme delivery, ensuring projects are delivered on time and on budget.

We work with various systems, but for this role, we are specifically looking for expertise in deploying Oracle Primavera Cloud (OPC) and/or Primavera Unifier.

Experience in planning, along with a strong command of platforms such as Oracle Primavera P6, Aconex, and Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI), would be a valuable asset. You’ll not only lead implementation projects but also lead software sales by demonstrating the value of these tools to potential clients. Across all these areas, your excellent communication skills will be key.

You’ll join a rapidly growing team responsible for sales and implementation of the project controls systems. There will be opportunities to manage people, lead projects, drive system sales, develop internal processes, and take on key business development activities.

Adaptability is key. Given our rapid growth, your focus might shift from Oracle systems to project controls, planning and digital transformation projects. If you're open to that kind of flexibility, this role is for you!

Team

This role is part of our Project Management Consultancy which focuses on:

Understanding what the real problems of projects are
Implementing the best solutions to those problems
Developing scalable best practices, tools and technology

More specifically you will join the Integrated Project Controls Systems (IPCS) team who are industry leaders in improving delivery of complex projects through deployment of the most suitable software on the market.

Your top three objectives

To make construction projects deliver to near perfection
To create scalable and repeatable solutions to common problems
To develop yourself and everyone around you

Your Top 5 Responsibilities

Own the implementation plan: Own the system implementation plan and drive software configuration and adoption to achieve desired outcomes. We believe in your ability to assess the situation and commit to what is achievable.
Develop impactful solutions: Leverage your planning and project controls expertise to design and configure scalable, optimized and fit-for-purpose solutions on Oracle systems.
Manage people and process: While great technical solutions are important, successfully deploying them to a large user base requires more than just a good config. Engaging all relevant stakeholders is key, ensuring they understand that the new processes and tools are designed to make their lives easier.
Drive system sales: Identify leads and opportunities to deploy systems across new and existing clients. Support pre-sales activities by showcasing software capabilities and building compelling prototypes.
Develop everyone: Maximise the development of your team personally and professionally and educate our clients to improve as well. (even if you are junior you can help your leader develop too!)

Your Capabilities

We are looking for a self-driven individual who can leverage their project controls expertise to configure and deploy flagship Oracle Construction systems. We’re seeking someone with strong industry experience, a solid reputation, and an established network that can be leveraged to help drive our sales pipeline.

At Laminar, self-development is at the heart of what we do. If you are open to feedback, eager to learn, and motivated by a continuous growth journey that supports both personal and professional development, then keep reading; this role might be what you’re looking for.

What matters most to us is your attitude, drive, and people skills. If you’ve got a knack for configuring Oracle systems and are a natural communicator who easily builds strong relationships with project stakeholders and potential clients, this role could be perfect for you. Most importantly, you should enjoy the work and be excited to learn and grow along the way.

As a candidate, you should have:

Must-Have
(The fundamentals)

Mastery: Experience in sales and implementation of Oracle Systems in the construction industry
Communication: Proficient communicator in written and verbal English, with ability to convey messages with clarity, motivate teams and lead meetings effectively. Kind and empathetic active listener, capable of giving and receiving constructive feedback.

What kinds of projects would I be working on?

(such as advanced manufacturing, pharmaceuticals, and semiconductors), or complex building projects

Who are our clients?

Major owners/operators and main contractors with project values between £1m and £1bn+ globally.

Where would I be working?

One week you might be working from home. The next, you might travel to the site to meet the construction teams and help organise them. You’re tasked with understanding and solving common problems. We don’t want to reinvent the wheel every time, so you’ll be responsible for documenting new solutions and evolving ones we’ve developed. This goes into our knowledge repository, which we’re going to open source to the industry.

new_jobs.title: Data Analyst - Routing & Sortation
new_jobs.description:
Relay is fundamentally reshaping how goods move in an online era.
Backed by Europe’s largest-ever logistics Series A ($35M) led by deep-tech investors Plural, and a recently closed Series B ($95M), Relay is scaling faster than 99% of venture-backed startups. We're assembling the most talent-dense team the logistics industry has ever seen

Relay’s Mission is
to free commerce from friction
. Today, high delivery costs act as a hidden tax on e-commerce, quietly shaping what can be sold online and limiting who can participate. We envision a world where more goods move more freely between more people
, making the online shopping experience seamless and accessible to everyone.

THE TEAM

~160 people, around half in engineering, product and data
45+ advanced degrees across computer science, mathematics and operations research
Thousands of data points captured, calculated, analysed and predicted for every single parcel we handle
An intellectually vibrant culture of first‑principles thinking, tight feedback loops and relentless experimentation

Overview

Relay is a parcel delivery network. Every night, parcels from online retailers arrive at our sort centres, are sorted into delivery routes, and go out the next day with couriers. Two things have to go right for that to work.

Routing
is the planning side: software that decides, before parcels have even arrived, which ones to expect, how to group them into routes, and how to make those routes efficient for couriers to drive. Sortation
is the physical side: warehouse teams and sorting robots turning a building full of parcels into neatly separated routes, thousands of times a night.

The two are tightly coupled. If the plan expects a parcel that never arrives, a courier's route has a hole in it. If the warehouse sorts a parcel the plan didn't expect, it has nowhere to go. This role owns the analytics across both: spotting when either side is off, working out why, and building the case for what to change.

Your work splits between a daily operational rhythm (is the network healthy this morning, and if not, why) and deeper investigations (what is driving cost, where is the plan falling short of what's possible, what should we change). Your analysis won't sit in a dashboard waiting to be discovered - it will change which parcels get planned for, how warehouse shifts are scheduled, and where the operation focuses its improvement efforts.

Relay operates a centralised data team of around 30 data engineers, analysts, and data scientists, with analysts embedded into teams across the business. to free commerce from friction
. Today, high delivery costs act as a hidden tax on e-commerce, quietly shaping what can be sold online and limiting who can participate. We envision a world where more goods move more freely between more people
, making the online shopping experience seamless and accessible to everyone.

THE TEAM

~160 people, around half in engineering, product and data
45+ advanced degrees across computer science, mathematics and operations research
Thousands of data points captured, calculated, analysed and predicted for every single parcel we handle
An intellectually vibrant culture of first‑principles thinking, tight feedback loops and relentless experimentation

Overview

Relay's Pitstop network is the convenience-store backbone of the operation. Customers drop off and collect parcels at these locations, Middle Mile drivers hand off and pick up, and the whole network depends on independent retailers behaving in ways that make Relay work. They aren't Relay staff. We don't control their attention, their turnover, or what else is happening behind their counter. Every behaviour we need has to be produced through systems, incentives, and the app.

The Pitstop squad's job is to build those systems. Today the network runs at around 170k parcels a day, propped up by a small operations team and twelve LiveOps FTE absorbing the day-to-day breakage. The squad's mission is to take the network from 170k to 2M parcels a day without LiveOps scaling linearly with it. That means systematising launch readiness, pitstop performance, pricing structure, and retention so the same number of operators can support a network twelve times the size.

As a Data Analyst in the Pitstop squad, you will own the analytics that make all of this measurable. Are launches hitting day-1 quality? Is handover speed improving where new in-app behaviour nudges have rolled out? Which pitstops are heading for churn and why? What's actually driving LiveOps ticket load, and which interventions are removing it? You'll build the monitoring layer the squad relies on, run the cost and performance investigations that shape what gets built next, and become the squad's source of truth on what's working.

Relay operates a centralised data team of around 30 data engineers, analysts, and data scientists, with analysts embedded into squads across the business. Own the Pitstop squad's five outcome metrics: Launch Velocity, Handover Speed, Handover Accuracy, Pitstop Retention, and Indirect Cost per Parcel. Build the monitoring around them, investigate movement, and translate the numbers into next actions for the squad.
Run the analytics behind pitstop performance and pricing: which behaviours move handover speed, how commercial tiers and clawbacks are landing, which pitstops are systematically under- or over-performing, and what the in-app nudges are actually changing on the counter.
Quantify the impact of squad initiatives in cost terms: how much LiveOps load did this self-serve flow remove, how much Middle Mile driver time did this handover prompt unlock, and what is the CPP impact of retention work on mature pitstops.
Build launch readiness analytics: cohort ramp curves, time-to-maturity, where new pitstops break in week one, and how the launch playbook should evolve as volume grows.
Build the retention layer: a health score for pitstops, at-risk alerting, churn diagnosis triaged by cause, and the feedback loop back into acquisition and onboarding.
Investigate LiveOps ticket load by category and reason. Quantify what each ticket type costs, where the volume is concentrated, and which pillars should systematise it next.
Define KPIs and build dashboards that make Pitstop performance transparent to the squad, to operations, and to leadership.
Maintain and extend the squad's dbt models and data pipelines that underpin the monitoring layer.

Every bank in Europe had to apply the EBA's definition of default by January 2021. Applying it was one thing. Making the mortgage data agree with it, loan part by loan part, all the way into the Finance and Risk reports, is the job that's still open.

That's this one.

The bank's mortgage business runs a programme on the Definition of Default: every exposure classified correctly under the EBA rules, and a default flag that holds in every report downstream. You'd join the team that owns the data side of it. Reporting solutions, data processes, data quality.

• SQL. You size the population, check what was built, and find where the data is wrong before the regulator does
• Be the person the team asks what the regulation actually requires of default data

new_jobs.title: Global Sustainability Data Analyst & Developer – Data, Tools & Methods
new_jobs.description:
At ABB, we help industries outrun - leaner and cleaner. Here, progress is an expectation - for you, your team, and the world. As a global market leader, we’ll give you what you need to make it happen. It won’t always be easy, growing takes grit. But at ABB, you’ll never run alone. Run what runs the world.

This role sits within ABB's Robotics business, a leading global robotics company. We're entering an exciting new chapter as we’ve announced the plan for SoftBank Group to acquire ABB Robotics. SoftBank is a globally recognized technology group and investor/operator focused on AI, robotics, and next-generation computing. By joining us now, you’ll be part of a pioneering team shaping the future of robotics—working alongside world-class experts in a fast-moving, innovation-driven environment.

This Position Reports To

Global Head of Sustainability

In our new Robotics company, you will strengthen Sustainability’s analytical backbone by building data models, templates, and dashboards that measure performance across climate, circularity, waste, water, energy and materials. You will help set up efficient tools and methods (Power BI, Excel, shared templates), ensure data quality, and enable clear insights for decision‑making across the business. You will also help digitalize and automate our processes, strengthen analytics and decision-making.

This role is part of ABB’s Robotics business, it bridges IT and sustainability, requiring someone who can code, communicate, and think strategically about data governance.

By joining us now, you’ll be part of a dynamic and fast-paced organization at the forefront of robotics innovation. As we transition into a separate entity outside the ABB Group, you’ll have the chance to shape the future, grow your career, and work alongside world-class experts in a more agile and entrepreneurial environment.

The work model for the role is hybrid.

This is a global role; the preferred locations are: Krakow or Västerås, with flexibility for the right candidate

Your Responsibilities

Build Enterprise Analytics Solutions – Develop and maintain scalable dashboards and reports using Power BI, Excel, Snowflake, and Streamlit that track Scope 1–3 emissions, circularity, waste, water, energy, and key sustainability KPIs with advanced data modelling and interactive visualizations
Standardize Data Frameworks & Templates – Design and implement reusable data collection processes, templates, and standards across Sustainability, Operations, Supply Chain, HR, Finance, and R&D to ensure consistency, quality, and audit readiness
Bridge IT & Sustainability – Translate sustainability business needs into data requirements; collaborate with IS/IT on toolchain decisions, connectors, and data infrastructure while representing the sustainability perspective
Ensure Data Integrity & Governance – Set up efficient validation, transformation, and refresh cycles; document calculation rules and assumptions; run quality checks to maintain audit-ready datasets and reliable decision-making
Enable Trend Analysis & Insights – Support topic leads with ad hoc analyses, scenario modelling (e.g., decarbonization pathways), and performance dashboards that drive strategy and accountability across the business

Essential Skills

Qualifications for the role:

Baschelors/ Masters degree in Data/Analytics, Engineering, Sustainability or a related field
 3–5 years of hands-on experience in data analysis, business intelligence, or analytics consulting
Strong understanding of dimensional modeling, data warehousing concepts, master data management, and building scalable reporting architectures; experience designing data validation frameworks and quality assurance processes
 Demonstrated experience managing and reporting ESG metrics, emissions accounting (Scope 1, 2, 3), circularity, waste, water, and sustainability KPIs; familiarity with building templates for multi-stakeholder data collection
Proven ability to explain complex technical analyses to non-experts, work effectively in multicultural teams, and adapt quickly as tools, priorities, and business needs evolve; fluency in English
Advanced proficiency in Power BI or Tableau, SQL for data querying and transformation, Python or R for scripting and automation, and expert-level Excel (data modeling, pivot tables, automation) is a plus.
Excellent communication skills in English

Essential Attributes

Data quality focused – You validate assumptions, document logic, and catch issues early.
Systems thinker – You understand data flows and downstream impacts.
Self-sufficient builder – You prototype practical solutions independently.
Clear communicator – You explain technical topics clearly to non-experts.
Adaptable – You stay effective as needs, tools, and priorities change.
Collaborative – You partner well with IT while representing sustainability needs.

You will join a dynamic, talented, high performing team, where you will be able to thrive.

We value people from different backgrounds. Could this be your story? Apply today or visit www.abb.com to read more about us and learn about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

About The Role

The Project Manager is accountable for the successful delivery of complex, cross-functional business and technology initiatives within a fast-paced Insurtech environment. This position leads projects from planning through implementation, transition, and closeout, ensuring that intended business outcomes are achieved within approved scope, schedule, budget, quality, and risk parameters.

The Project Manager provides structure and leadership across multidisciplinary teams that may include insurance operations, underwriting, product, technology, data, finance, compliance, legal, and external partners. This individual is accountable for planning, coordinating, governing, and delivering projects including driving execution, facilitating critical decisions, managing competing priorities, and maintaining accountability across all levels of the project.

Successful candidates will combine disciplined project management expertise with business acumen, sound judgment, and the ability to lead through influence in an evolving, technology-enabled insurance organization.

Key Responsibilities

Project Leadership and Delivery

Lead complex business, operational, product, and technology projects from initiation through implementation and closeout.
Establish the project governance and delivery structure, scope, objectives, success measures, milestones, and implementation approach.
Translate strategic business objectives into actionable project plans with clearly defined deliverables, owners, dependencies, and timelines.
Assume accountability for overall project performance, including scope, schedule, budget, quality, risk, and business outcomes.
Drive project execution across cross-functional teams, ensuring that commitments are understood, monitored, and completed.
Maintain delivery momentum by identifying obstacles, resolving conflicts, and facilitating timely decisions.
Evaluate project performance and implement corrective actions when results deviate from approved plans.
Ensure projects transition successfully into ongoing business operations, with clear ownership and support models following implementation.

Scope, Schedule, and Budget Management

Define, validate, and manage project scope in partnership with executive sponsors, business owners, and key stakeholders.
Develop and maintain integrated project plans that account for business, operational, technical, vendor, and regulatory dependencies.
Establish realistic schedules based on project complexity, resource capacity, organizational priorities, and implementation requirements.
Develop, manage, and monitor project budgets, forecasts, vendor costs, and financial performance, as applicable.
Assess the impact of requested changes to scope, schedule, cost, resources, risk, and anticipated benefits.
Lead formal change-control processes and obtain appropriate stakeholder approval before implementing material changes.
Provide transparent reporting on project health, financial status, delivery risks, and forecasted outcomes.

Risk, Issue, and Dependency Management

Proactively identify, assess, and manage project risks, issues, assumptions, constraints, and dependencies.
Develop mitigation, contingency, and recovery plans for risks that could affect delivery or business outcomes.
Evaluate the business impact and urgency of project issues and drive timely resolution with accountable owners.
Escalate significant decisions, risks, resource constraints, and delivery concerns to project sponsors and PMO leadership.
Monitor dependencies across projects, systems, business areas, vendors, and implementation workstreams.
Apply sound judgment to balance speed, quality, cost, risk, and business value when recommending a course of action.
Maintain clear decision, risk, issue, and change records throughout the project lifecycle.

Stakeholder and Executive Management

Serve as the primary delivery leader and central point of accountability for assigned projects.
Establish productive working relationships with executive sponsors, business leaders, subject matter experts, technology teams, vendors, and implementation partners.
Clarify roles, decision rights, escalation paths, and stakeholder expectations at the beginning of each project.
Provide concise, decision-oriented updates to executives, steering committees, and governance groups.
Present project recommendations, alternatives, tradeoffs, risks, and business impacts in a clear and actionable manner.
Facilitate alignment when stakeholders have competing goals, priorities, or perspectives.
Build consensus and secure decisions necessary to maintain project progress.
Manage stakeholder expectations throughout the project lifecycle and communicate changes proactively.

Cross-Functional Team Leadership

Lead multidisciplinary project teams across insurance operations, underwriting, product, technology, data, finance, legal, compliance, and other business functions.
Establish a culture of accountability, collaboration, transparency, and results within the project team.
Define project roles and responsibilities and ensure team members understand their commitments.
Partner with functional leaders to secure qualified project resources and address competing capacity demands.
Facilitate effective collaboration between business and technology teams.
Hold workstream leaders and project contributors accountable for agreed deliverables and deadlines.
Support productive conflict resolution and remove barriers that could affect team performance or delivery.
Provide project direction without relying on formal supervisory authority.

Technology and Insurtech Delivery

Lead initiatives involving insurance platforms, digital products, workflow automation, systems integration, data solutions, operational transformation, or customer-facing technology.
Partner with product, engineering, data, quality assurance, information security, and business teams throughout the delivery lifecycle.
Coordinate business and technical workstreams to ensure requirements, solution design, testing, implementation, and operational readiness remain aligned.
Ensure that business requirements and expected outcomes are understood and traceable throughout project delivery.
Manage project activities across Agile, Waterfall, and hybrid delivery models based on the needs of the initiative.
Coordinate release planning, testing readiness, deployment activities, implementation support, and post-launch stabilization.
Work with appropriate partners to ensure projects consider security, privacy, compliance, data integrity, and operational-resilience requirements.
Support the successful integration of third-party platforms and external technology partners.

Insurance Operations and Regulatory Alignment

Develop an understanding of the insurance processes, products, controls, and operating models affected by each project.
Partner with underwriting, operations, claims, finance, actuarial, compliance, legal, and technology stakeholders as required by the initiative.
Ensure relevant regulatory, contractual, audit, security, and compliance considerations are incorporated into project plans.
Identify operational impacts resulting from changes to systems, workflows, products, data, or business processes.
Coordinate with control functions to obtain required reviews, approvals, and documentation.
Promote solutions that improve scalability, data quality, operational efficiency, customer experience, and business performance.
Ensure project teams appropriately document material decisions, requirements, controls, and approvals.

Vendor and Partner Management

Manage project activities involving software providers, consultants, implementation partners, and other third parties.
Integrate vendor plans, milestones, dependencies, and deliverables into the overall project plan.
Monitor vendor performance against contractual commitments, project requirements, delivery dates, and quality expectations.
Facilitate resolution of vendor-related risks, delivery gaps, and dependency issues.
Partner with procurement, legal, information security, finance, and business owners throughout vendor selection and implementation activities.
Review vendor recommendations and challenge assumptions when necessary to protect project objectives.
Escalate material vendor performance concerns and support the development of corrective-action plans.

Change Management and Business Readiness

Assess how project outcomes will affect employees, customers, partners, workflows, systems, controls, and organizational responsibilities.
Integrate change management, communication, training, adoption, and business-readiness activities into the overall delivery plan.
Partner with business leaders and change management resources to identify impacted stakeholder groups and adoption risks.
Ensure impacted teams are prepared to operate new processes, systems, products, or capabilities before implementation.
Establish implementation-readiness criteria and facilitate go-live decisions with project sponsors and operational owners.
Monitor adoption, stabilization, and early performance following implementation.
Ensure ownership is formally transitioned to the appropriate business and operational teams.

Governance and Performance Reporting

Establish project governance that supports effective oversight, timely decisions, and clear accountability.
Lead steering committee meetings, executive reviews, project working sessions, and delivery checkpoints.
Develop accurate project status reports, executive presentations, dashboards, forecasts, and decision materials.
Provide objective assessments of project health rather than relying solely on completed activities or reported progress.
Monitor delivery performance against approved scope, schedule, budget, quality, risk, and benefit expectations.
Ensure project records and approvals meet PMO governance and documentation requirements.
Conduct project closeout reviews and capture lessons learned, delivery insights, and improvement opportunities.
Contribute to the continued development of PMO standards, methodologies, governance practices, and portfolio reporting.

new_jobs.title: Assistant Project Manager - Heavy Civil
new_jobs.description:
Assistant Project Manager

Fay, S&B USA Construction builds complex infrastructure across the Mid-Atlantic such as major bridges, tunnels, highways, and P3 programs that demand technical depth and strong field leadership. Safety, quality, and schedule are not checkboxes here — they are the standard we hold ourselves to on every project, every day. Whether you are early in your career looking for the kind of project exposure that accelerates growth, or a seasoned professional ready to lead work at the highest level, you will find both here. We invest in the people who build with us, and the projects we take on reflect that commitment.

Job Summary

The Assistant Project Manager is a pivotal role in managing and executing high-value heavy-highway and heavy-civil construction projects. This position involves significant responsibilities in project coordination, team supervision, financial management, and compliance, along with proficient use of specialized construction management software.

Coordinate and oversee project planning and execution, using Oracle P6 Scheduling Software for schedule management.
Ensure project milestones and goals are achieved within the set timelines and budgets.
Facilitate effective communication and collaboration among project teams, stakeholders, and clients.
Utilize Microsoft Office Applications (PowerPoint, Word, Excel, SharePoint, OneDrive) for creating presentations, reports, and effective information sharing.
Oversee the creation and maintenance of comprehensive project documentation, ensuring accuracy and compliance.
Employ Microsoft Power BI for advanced reporting, data analysis, and progress tracking.
Actively engage with clients, subcontractors, and other stakeholders, ensuring their needs and expectations are effectively managed and addressed.
Provide regular project updates and maintain transparent communication channels.
Assist in managing project budgets, utilizing Excel and Viewpoint Vista ERP System for financial tracking and reporting.
Identify cost-saving opportunities and contribute to budgetary control and financial optimization.
Ensure all project activities comply with quality standards, safety regulations, and contractual obligations.
Use Autodesk AutoCAD or Bentley MicroStation for design verification and quality assurance.
Assist in identifying and mitigating project risks, developing effective solutions to challenges encountered during project execution.
Implement and oversee risk management strategies and contingency plans.
Support in leading and developing the project team, fostering a collaborative and inclusive work environment.
Contribute to team training and skill development initiatives.

Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Civil Engineering, Construction Management, or a related field.
5+ years of experience in heavy-highway or heavy-civil construction projects.
Proficient in Microsoft Office Applications (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, SharePoint, Power BI), Oracle P6 Scheduling Software, and Autodesk AutoCAD or Bentley MicroStation.
Strong leadership, financial management, and communication skills.
Excellent organizational, analytical, and problem-solving abilities.
Ability to work effectively in both a team setting and independently.

Physical Demands

Capability to work in diverse field conditions and to navigate construction sites.
Occasional lifting of materials and equipment may be required.

What We Offer

Competitive compensation, medical/dental/vision coverage, paid PTO, paid parental leave, 401(k) with a company match, life insurance, disability insurance, training, career planning, and more.

Core Values

Work Safely: Safety is our Culture
Deliver Return: Earning a fair profit increases our long-term value
Value People: Take Care of Employees and They Will Take Care of Clients
Act with Integrity: Honesty Builds Trust
Provide Solutions: Better Solutions Yield Greater Satisfaction

Equal Opportunity Employer

S&B USA Construction and all its affiliate companies are committed to providing equal employment opportunities in all aspects of employment to qualified individuals without regard to the following criteria: race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity) national origin, age, disability, genetic information, protected veteran status, as well as any other prohibited criteria under any local, state or federal law applicable to S&B USA Construction. As part of the firm’s equal employment opportunity statement, S&B USA Construction will also take affirmative action to ensure that minorities, women, veterans, and qualified people with disabilities are considered for employment and promotional opportunities.

If a reasonable accommodation is needed for the interview process, please contact recruiting@shikunusa.com or 412-471-4200 ext. 1032.

Agency Policy: Please
refer to our Agency Policy and disclaimer statement regarding resume submissions. https://www.shikunusa.com/notice-to-staffing-agencies

Job Title: Project Manager – Ground-Up Commercial Construction

Job Description

This Project Manager role focuses exclusively on ground-up commercial construction projects in sectors such as healthcare, K–12 schools, higher education, and living facilities. The position oversees large-scale projects typically ranging from $15 million to $50 million (and up to $70 million), ensuring they are delivered safely, on schedule, within budget, and to a high standard of quality. You will lead project teams across multiple jobs, drive lean construction practices, and play a key role in shaping impactful facilities that serve communities across Northern Virginia and surrounding markets.

Responsibilities

Lead end-to-end management of ground-up commercial construction projects, typically ranging from $15 million to $50 million and up to $70 million in value.
Build, maintain, and refine comprehensive CPM project schedules from schematic design (SD) through construction documents (CD), using a lean approach to establish and track all significant milestones.
Use Primavera P6 to develop, update, and communicate detailed project schedules, ensuring all stakeholders understand sequencing, milestones, and critical paths.
Explain lean scheduling concepts to subcontractors and clients, including the Owner’s value for the project, project-specific parameters, and overall project sequencing.
Apply the Last Planner System to pull plan from established project milestones and manage the weekly work plan, promoting collaboration and accountability among project participants.
Use and manage Short Interval Production Schedules to maintain productivity and address short-term planning needs on the job site.
Develop and implement recovery schedules when needed to bring projects back on track and meet contractual deadlines.
Pre-qualify subcontractors, conduct subcontractor visits, and verify that trade partners meet quality, safety, and performance expectations.
Ensure digital and field mock-ups are planned, executed, and reviewed before work is put in place, using these mock-ups to validate design intent and quality standards.
Request and direct Virtual Design and Construction (VDC) needs and effectively navigate BIM models to support coordination and clash detection.
Lead project budgeting from a lean perspective, teaching staff the difference between the budget required to complete the project and the estimated budget, and seeking opportunities to increase contingency or fee where appropriate.
Oversee project billings and financial closeout, ensuring projects are fully closed within 30 days of construction completion, including final payment from the owner and full payment to subcontractors.
Plan, schedule, create agendas for, and lead large pre-construction meetings that include the owner, design team, and subcontractors, ensuring alignment on scope, schedule, logistics, and expectations.
Assist with estimating and preconstruction efforts ahead of bids, including developing project logistics plans, preliminary schedules, general conditions, and staffing plans.
Supervise 5–10 staff members across multiple projects, including Administrative Assistants, Project Engineers, and Superintendents, providing overall direction, coordination, and performance evaluation.
Promote and enforce safety standards on all projects, ensuring compliance with OSHA requirements and company safety policies.
Communicate effectively with owners, design teams, subcontractors, and internal staff, maintaining clear documentation and fostering collaborative relationships.
Monitor project progress in the field, evaluate schedule waste, and implement process improvements to enhance efficiency and reduce delays.
Ensure high-quality construction outcomes by proactively managing subcontractor performance, field execution, and adherence to project specifications.
Support the delivery of impactful healthcare, K–12, higher education, and Adult living projects that positively influence communities and the built environment.

Essential Skills

Minimum of 5+ years of project management experience in commercial construction, with at least 4 years in a full Project Manager role (not Assistant Project Manager).
Proven experience managing ground-up commercial construction projects, specifically in healthcare, K–12 schools, higher education, or adult living.
Successful track record overseeing projects between $15 million and $70 million in value.
OSHA 30-hour certification.
Current First Aid certification.
Current CPR certification.
Ability to build and manage CPM schedules from SD to CD level drawings, applying lean scheduling principles.
Proficiency with Primavera P6 for detailed project scheduling and schedule management.
Experience explaining and implementing lean scheduling concepts with subcontractors and clients.
Strong understanding of Owner value, project-specific parameters, and project sequencing in a commercial construction environment.
Experience using the Last Planner method to develop pull plans and manage weekly work plans.
Ability to use and manage Short Interval Production Schedules and develop recovery schedules when necessary.
Experience pre-qualifying subcontractors and conducting subcontractor visits to assess capabilities and performance.
Ability to coordinate and review digital and field mock-ups to validate quality and design intent.
Experience requesting and directing Virtual Design needs and navigating BIM models for coordination.
Strong budgeting skills from a lean perspective, including teaching staff and distinguishing between required and estimated budgets.
Demonstrated ability to seek additional contingency or fee through thorough understanding of the entire project.
Experience ensuring timely project closeout, including final owner payment and full subcontractor payment within established timeframes.
Ability to schedule, prepare agendas for, and lead large pre-construction meetings with owners, design teams, and subcontractors.
Proven leadership skills supervising 5–10 staff members across multiple projects, including Administrative Assistants, Project Engineers, and Superintendents.
Experience assisting with estimating and preconstruction activities, including logistics, scheduling, general conditions, and staffing plans.
Strong communication and coordination skills in a commercial construction environment.

Additional Skills & Qualifications

Experience in ground-up commercial projects in healthcare, K–12 schools, colleges, higher education, and adult living facilities.
working with general contractors on large, complex commercial projects.
Familiarity with lean construction principles and the Last Planner System.
Comfort working with Virtual Design and Construction tools and BIM models.
Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously while maintaining high standards of safety, quality, and schedule adherence.
Strong organizational and time-management skills, with the ability to prioritize and balance competing demands.
Commitment to delivering projects that positively impact communities and the future of education and healthcare.
Interest in long-term stability and growth opportunities within expanding markets such as Winchester, VA and Richmond, VA.

Work Environment

The role operates in a dynamic commercial construction environment, combining office-based planning and coordination with frequent visits to active job sites. Project work focuses on ground-up commercial facilities in healthcare, K–12 education, higher education, living, primarily in Northern Virginia and surrounding markets. On-site work involves regular exposure to moving mechanical parts, high and sometimes precarious locations, and varying outside weather conditions. At times, you may encounter wet or humid conditions, fumes or airborne particles, toxic or caustic chemicals, extreme cold or heat, risk of electrical shock, risk of radiation, and vibration. The noise level is typically consistent with active construction sites, requiring awareness of safety protocols and use of appropriate personal protective equipment. The organization emphasizes safety, quality, and lean construction practices, and offers a stable, growth-oriented culture with a long history in the industry and opportunities to work on meaningful community-focused projects.

Job Type & Location

This is a Contract to Hire position based out of Winchester, VA.

Pay And Benefits

The pay range for this position is $43.27 - $66.00/hr.

Individual compensation offered for this position within this range will depend on many factors, including qualifications, skills, relevant experience, job knowledge, geographic location, internal equity, and other pertinent job-related factors.

Eligibility requirements apply to some benefits and may depend on your job classification and length of employment. Benefits are subject to change and may be subject to specific elections, plan, or program terms. If eligible, the benefits available for this temporary role may include the following:

new_jobs.title: Senior Data Analyst - Last Mile
new_jobs.description:
Relay is fundamentally reshaping how goods move in an online era.
Backed by Europe’s largest-ever logistics Series A ($35M) led by deep-tech investors Plural, and a recently closed Series B ($95M), Relay is scaling faster than 99% of venture-backed startups. We're assembling the most talent-dense team the logistics industry has ever seen

Relay’s Mission is
to free commerce from friction
. Today, high delivery costs act as a hidden tax on e-commerce, quietly shaping what can be sold online and limiting who can participate. We envision a world where more goods move more freely between more people
, making the online shopping experience seamless and accessible to everyone.

THE TEAM

~160 people, around half in engineering, product and data
45+ advanced degrees across computer science, mathematics and operations research
Thousands of data points captured, calculated, analysed and predicted for every single parcel we handle
An intellectually vibrant culture of first‑principles thinking, tight feedback loops and relentless experimentation

The Opportunity

Relay’s Last Mile network runs on couriers - tens of thousands of them, doing real work in the physical world every day. Whether each parcel gets delivered successfully depends on the decisions and behaviours of the courier on route. We're hiring for a Senior Data Analyst to own how Relay measures and improves courier excellence: how we shape what happens on the doorstep, and how we manage performance before and after that interaction.

This role works with the whole of the Last Mile team and partners closely with data scientists, engineers and operators across the squad. There's a v1 of performance management already running; you'll own its evolution into something materially better.

Last Mile

Handover Optimisation:
Every handover is a trade-off between competing outcomes - speed, quality, and risk. Moving any one of them can have knock-on effects on the others, and finding the right balance is one of the most interesting analytical problems in the network. Your job is to make those trade-offs visible, model them, and find the levers that move the network in the right direction. You'll run the experiments, design the measurement, and quantify what actually works.

Performance Management:
Relay already has a framework for measuring courier performance, and it feeds into how work is distributed. The job now is to ensure it drives fleet quality - defining the right behaviours to measure, evaluating the interventions designed to help couriers shift those behaviours, and closing the loop so the framework continuously improves. You'll partner with product, ops and engineering across this work, with the analytics owned by you.

Courier-facing analytics:
Couriers are the end users of much of this work. You'll think about how performance and rewards are made transparent to them, and you'll run experiments to evaluate whether interventions are actually working for couriers and for Relay.

Who Will Thrive In This Role

You're a strong analyst who thinks in systems. You break complex problems into components and know where the real opportunity lies.
You are successful working with high autonomy and are excited to operate in a Product/Programme Manager like capacity, defining the roadmap as well as executing against it.
You care about solving the problem more than which techniques you use.
You love working with smart, motivated people.
You're fluent in SQL.
You're comfortable across the analytical spectrum - designing and reading experiments, building risk scores and segmentation, and shipping descriptive analysis that drives a decision the same week.
You communicate inclusively with non-technical team members.
You love seeing the impact of your work play out in a daily operation.
Bonus: You have experience working on performance management, marketplace quality, operational analytics or another relevant domain.

Compensation, Benefits & Workplace

Generous equity, richer than 99% of European startups, with annual top-ups to share Relay’s success.
Private health & dental coverage, so comprehensive you’d need to be a partner at a Magic Circle law firm to match it.
25 days of holidays
Enhanced parental leave.
Located in Shoreditch, our office set-up enables the kind of in-person interactions that drive impact. We work 4 days on-site, with 1 day remote.
Hardware of your choice.
Extensive perks (gym subsidies, cycle-to-work, Friday office lunch, covered Uber home and dinner for late nights, and more).

Who Thrives at Relay?

Aim with Precision: You define problems clearly and measure your impact meticulously.
Play to Win: You chase bold bets, tackle the hard stuff, and view constraints as fuel, not friction.
1% Better Every Day: You believe that small, consistent improvements lead to exponential growth. You move quickly, deliver results, and learn from every experience.
All In, All the Time: You show up and step up. You take ownership from start to finish and do what it takes to deliver when it counts.
People-Powered Greatness: You invest in your teammates. You give and receive feedback with care and candour. You build trust through high standards and shared success.
Grow the Whole Pie: You seek out win-win solutions for merchants, couriers, and our customers, because when they thrive, so do we.

If these resonate, and you combine strong technical fundamentals with entrepreneurial drive, let’s connect.

Relay is an equal-opportunity employer
committed to diversity, inclusion, and fostering a workplace where everyone thrives.
